00b146e96c08.en: Harry’s body and soul shivered in disgust at the thought of slurping an eyeball on top of coagulated jelly hors d’oeuvres with a full stomach. The awful taste of coagulated bloody salty mixed with vinegar taste of the nari gel still felt like he had just slurped it down last night—except that happened days ago instead.
00b146e96c08.t: Tubuh dan jiwa Harry menggigil jijik memikirkan menghirup biji mata di atas hors d’oeuvres jeli yang membeku dengan perut yang penuh. Rasa buruk darah masin yang membeku bercampur rasa cuka nari gel itu masih terasa seperti dia baru menghirupnya malam tadi—kecuali ia berlaku beberapa hari lepas.

02601e73d65c.en: Letting out a dissonant hum, Hiromi also looked at the board. “I haven’t heard of that, but yeah, I prefer targeting the yellow ones, as those are worth more if you snipe all territories.”
02601e73d65c.t: Mengeluarkan dengungan sumbang, Hiromi turut memandang papan itu. “Aku tak pernah dengar pula, tapi ha, aku lebih suka sasarkan yang kuning, sebab yang tu lagi tinggi nilainya kalau kau tembak semua wilayah.”

035fdc671e1b.en: Harry took another sip of his strong drink, vividly picturing The Dead Wozen tavern Hiromi was describing, including the other adventurers with him.
035fdc671e1b.t: Harry menghirup lagi minumannya yang kuat, membayangkan dengan jelas kedai minum The Dead Wozen yang Hiromi gambarkan, termasuk pengembara-pengembara lain bersamanya.

053070761f65.en: “SEE? It’s all about mindset! You know what, Harry? You’re cool! So why not play a bit of territory snipping to celebrate?” Hiromi pointed to the nearby odd-looking dartboard. It kinda looked like a bird’s-eye view of a baseball field—that is, if you rotated the field to make a complete circle. There were multiple zones with different colors each.
053070761f65.t: “NAMPAK? Semuanya pasal minda! Kau tahu, Harry? Kau best! Jadi apa kata kita main tembak wilayah sikit untuk meraikan?” Hiromi menunjuk ke arah papan dart yang kelihatan pelik berdekatan. Ia agak kelihatan seperti pandangan mata burung padang besbol—iaitu, jika kau memutar padang itu untuk membuat bulatan lengkap. Ada beberapa zon dengan warna berbeza setiap satu.

097fa426482a.en: “C’mon, Kaiana! I was just saying—” Hiromi took a gulp of his beer. The glass was twice as big as hers—so big it had to look bigger than her head. “We got it done! That’s what matters!”
097fa426482a.t: “Alah, Kaiana! Aku cuma cakap—” Hiromi meneguk birnya. Gelas itu dua kali ganda besar daripada gelasnya—begitu besar sehingga kelihatan lebih besar daripada kepalanya. “Kita dah siapkan! Itu yang penting!”

0cd1a9157fd1.en: Is that how you do it? Harry couldn’t stop gazing at the pure muddling muscle action. He looked at his own arms for comparison, and they were downright feminine compared to Hiromi’s.
0cd1a9157fd1.t: Macam tu ke caranya? Harry tidak dapat berhenti merenung aksi otot menumbuk yang tulen itu. Dia memandang lengannya sendiri sebagai perbandingan, dan ia benar-benar kewanitaan berbanding lengan Hiromi.

0ed9791429e0.en: Shivering from the touch of her cold hands, Harry cracked his neck by just moving it slightly. It was tender, but it seemed to be working fine. “I think so.” Embracing the left side of his neck, a flashback of Maiara’s leg rushing towards his neck sprung on him. “So—what happened?” Harry looked around the blurry familiar room. Everything seemed to look the same when he went to sleep. The drawing of the old Itagiba-looking guy fishing in the clouds and the desk where he signed the contract were still there, but he couldn’t see the bloody mess he had made—even after squinting his eyes. The fost stone lamp was still on the nightstand, but this time it was dead, revealing a whitish pearlescent-like stone inside the glass; removing the sheets covering his lower body, he noticed he was wearing nothing but a blue-with-white-stars boxers. I don’t remember wearing this—AH?! Something else, or rather the lack of something else, called to his attention—his gut was gone. “Wait! When did I lose all of this weight?”
0ed9791429e0.t: Menggigil kerana sentuhan tangannya yang sejuk, Harry meletupkan lehernya hanya dengan menggerakkannya sedikit. Ia lembut sakitnya, tetapi nampaknya berfungsi dengan baik. “Rasanya okey.” Memegang bahagian kiri lehernya, imbasan kaki Maiara yang meluru ke arah lehernya menerpa padanya. “Jadi—apa yang jadi?” Harry memandang sekeliling bilik yang kabur dan biasa itu. Segala-galanya kelihatan sama seperti ketika dia pergi tidur. Lukisan lelaki tua seperti Itagiba memancing di awan dan meja tempat dia menandatangani kontrak masih ada, tetapi dia tidak dapat melihat sepah berdarah yang dibuatnya—walaupun selepas mengecilkan matanya. Lampu fost stone masih di atas meja sisi katil, tetapi kali ini ia padam, mendedahkan batu keputihan seperti mutiara di dalam kaca; mengalihkan cadar yang menutupi bahagian bawah tubuhnya, dia perasan dia hanya memakai seluar dalam biru bercorak bintang putih. Aku tak ingat pakai ni—AH?! Sesuatu yang lain, atau lebih tepat ketiadaan sesuatu yang lain, menarik perhatiannya—perutnya sudah tiada. “Kejap! Bila saya turun berat sebanyak ni?”

11c9b280e6d5.en: Itanema’s eyes were drawn to the drink spilling on the floor, then the mess on the bar table. She glanced back at Hiromi with her usual neutral expression—even though she would likely be cleaning it. “There are no tabs here.”
11c9b280e6d5.t: Mata Itanema tertarik kepada minuman yang tertumpah di lantai, kemudian sepah di atas meja bar. Dia mengerling semula ke arah Hiromi dengan riak neutralnya yang biasa—walaupun dia mungkin yang akan membersihkannya. “Tak ada akaun kat sini.”

17d7d745d70b.en: Harry’s face reddened as he imagined the situation, feeling a certain defenseless vibe rising as he was dead or passed out—or whatever state he was in. “Eh—I think I’m feeling better now. Thank you—for taking care of me!” His eyes got the courage to look at Aurora’s caramel eyes, still showing the same genuine caring as before.
17d7d745d70b.t: Wajah Harry memerah ketika dia membayangkan situasi itu, merasakan getaran tidak berdaya tertentu timbul kerana dia mati atau pengsan—atau apa pun keadaannya. “Eh—rasanya saya dah rasa lebih baik sekarang. Terima kasih—sebab jaga saya!” Matanya mendapat keberanian untuk memandang mata karamel Aurora, yang masih menunjukkan kepedulian tulen yang sama seperti tadi.

18a52df26c2a.en: Hiromi’s threatening expression began waning as he placed the empty soap container back on the shelf. His silence and severe facade came crumbling down as he swung his head in an apparent denial that turned into acceptance. “I’m too drunk for this. You got me there. Fine. I will just give it to you then.” Hiromi turned back and walked closer to Arukia, digging his hand up into his short kilt-like clothing, getting close to his crotch.
18a52df26c2a.t: Riak mengancam Hiromi mula pudar sambil dia meletakkan bekas sabun yang kosong semula di rak. Kesunyian dan topeng seriusnya runtuh sambil dia menggeleng kepala dalam penafian yang jelas yang bertukar menjadi penerimaan. “Aku terlalu mabuk untuk ni. Kau menang kali ni. Baiklah. Aku bagi je kat kau.” Hiromi berpaling dan berjalan mendekati Arukia, menyeluk tangannya ke dalam pakaiannya yang seperti kilt pendek, menghampiri celah kangkangnya.

1a8ce30d006b.en: “My man—did you eat gyut early on, or is that pieces of your stomach?” Hiromi laughed as he pulled the handle above the toilet, letting an angry gush of water wash it away.
1a8ce30d006b.t: “Kawan aku—kau ada makan gyut tadi ke, atau itu cebisan perut kau?” Hiromi ketawa sambil menarik pemegang di atas tandas, membiarkan curahan air yang marah menghanyutkannya.

1d697b8c39c8.en: Harry let out a chuckle. “Can I help?”

1d89944f90f5.en: Blinking, Harry stood up slowly as his brain got caught up with the complex rules—at least for his current state. “—Yea? So I play next?”
1d89944f90f5.t: Berkelip, Harry berdiri perlahan-lahan sementara otaknya cuba mengejar peraturan yang rumit itu—sekurang-kurangnya untuk keadaannya sekarang. “—Ha? Jadi saya main lepas ni?”

2184458b850f.en: “Yea!” Harry’s fruity voice sounded like a true adventurer’s. He pounded the rest of his drink, then slapped it back on the messy bar table with a nice clack as he scrubbed his mouth on his forearm, blurting out in a drunken slur, “You’re coolio too!”
2184458b850f.t: “Yeah!” Suara Harry yang berbuah kedengaran seperti pengembara sejati. Dia meneguk habis baki minumannya, kemudian menghempasnya semula ke meja bar yang bersepah dengan bunyi berdetak yang sedap sambil mengesat mulutnya pada lengan bawahnya, terlepas cakap dengan pelat mabuk, “Awak pun best gila!”

22e134e2f537.en: “Yeah, she’s always trying to prove that she’s better than Yacamim—at least she’s good at Homeegg.” A more soothed, but still just as deep, voice came from the Darfaries male as he kept on holding the strange pose. “Aiight. Repeat what I’m doing.”
22e134e2f537.t: “Ha, dia sentiasa cuba buktikan yang dia lebih bagus daripada Yacamim—sekurang-kurangnya dia pandai main Homeegg.” Suara yang lebih tenang, tetapi masih sama dalam, datang dari lelaki Darfaries itu sambil dia terus mengekalkan pose pelik itu. “Okeylah. Ulang apa yang aku buat.”

232593596bab.en: “Yes?” The grandmotherly tone of the maid was still there, but her eyes seemed rather puzzled as she brought clothes to Harry. “You know what, hon? I saw the fight too, and you had it rough.” Going back to the same crochet bag, she dug around and pulled out a rectangular thatch box and slid it open, revealing a yellowish-with-red-chunks cake the width and girth of a finger inside. “Here’s a consolation prize from me, so keep this just between us, okay?”
232593596bab.t: “Ya?” Nada nenek pembantu rumah itu masih ada, tetapi matanya kelihatan agak hairan ketika dia membawa pakaian kepada Harry. “Kau tahu, nak? Makcik pun tengok pertarungan tu, dan kau memang teruk dikerjakan.” Kembali ke beg mengait yang sama, dia menyelongkar dan mengeluarkan kotak jerami berbentuk segi empat tepat dan menggelongsor membukanya, mendedahkan kek kekuningan berketul merah selebar dan setebal sebatang jari di dalamnya. “Nah hadiah saguhati dari makcik, jadi rahsiakan antara kita je, okey?”

233c2710ab6b.en: The hinge of the blue atrium door creaked softly, breaking through the laughter. Next, a monotonous female voice said, “Hiromi, I see you’re teaching Harry well, but Eiri is waiting on him.”
233c2710ab6b.t: Engsel pintu atrium biru berkeriut perlahan, menembusi gelak ketawa. Kemudian, suara wanita yang mendatar berkata, “Hiromi, saya nampak awak mengajar Harry dengan baik, tapi Eiri sedang menunggu dia.”

2672240e815f.en: Vol 2 Chapter I subchapter 5: Harry and the mohawked giant, seen from behind, crouch to look at something on the floor.
2672240e815f.t: Jilid 2 Bab I subbab 5: Harry dan gergasi berjambul mohawk, dilihat dari belakang, mencangkung untuk melihat sesuatu di lantai.

27db0a797203.en: Takeo was sitting silently with a ponderous face. He didn’t seem to take the bait.
27db0a797203.t: Takeo duduk diam dengan wajah termenung. Dia nampaknya tidak termakan umpan itu.

2962d1c5fb35.en: Harry presented himself to Eiri in her office with a sloppily clean face. His smile shone brightly; water drops ran from his wet hair, down his reddened culpable face, and dripped onto his shirt.
2962d1c5fb35.t: Harry menunjukkan dirinya kepada Eiri di pejabatnya dengan muka yang bersih secara selekeh. Senyumannya bersinar terang; titisan air mengalir dari rambutnya yang basah, menuruni wajahnya yang merah dan bersalah, dan menitis ke bajunya.

2e786fd39272.en: Eiri let go of her writing feather and stood up slowly. She patted her skirt as she spoke truthfully, “Yeah—you clearly have something you want to tell, so get it off your chest.” She came closer to Harry but then looked to be taken aback as her nose was attacked by something. “WOW—what were you doing? Did you drink lolish-floaters or what? Your BO is pretty bad too! *Hmmm—*why do you smell like a Darfaries armpit? Didn’t Aurora bathe you yesterday?”
2e786fd39272.t: Eiri melepaskan bulu penanya dan berdiri perlahan-lahan. Dia menepuk skirtnya sambil bercakap dengan jujur, “Ha—kau jelas ada sesuatu yang kau nak bagi tahu, jadi luahkan.” Dia mendekati Harry tetapi kemudian kelihatan tersentak kerana hidungnya diserang sesuatu. “WOW—apa yang kau buat? Kau minum lolish-floaters ke apa? Bau badan kau pun teruk juga! *Hmmm—*kenapa kau berbau macam ketiak Darfaries? Bukan ke Aurora dah mandikan kau semalam?”

2ff9e97c552c.en: Harry could feel this odd ritualistic bonding happening with him, but he couldn’t break away. Even his respiration froze for a few seconds. He sealed his lips tighly, worried about a possible sloppy kiss.
2ff9e97c552c.t: Harry dapat merasakan ikatan ritual yang ganjil ini berlaku dengannya, tetapi dia tidak dapat melepaskan diri. Malah pernafasannya membeku selama beberapa saat. Dia mengetap bibirnya rapat-rapat, bimbang akan ciuman yang selekeh.

32671dd3f9a4.en: “Here, hon, spit on it.” The grandmotherly maid rushed back into the bedroom with a pot.
32671dd3f9a4.t: “Nah, nak, ludah kat sini.” Pembantu rumah seperti nenek itu bergegas kembali ke bilik tidur dengan sebuah periuk.

337a8b631018.en: “OH?” A gasp came out of Harry. Feeling his tension washing away, he blurted out, “So—Maiara is always like that?”
337a8b631018.t: “OH?” Satu tercungap keluar daripada Harry. Merasakan ketegangannya hilang, dia terlepas cakap, “Jadi—Maiara memang selalu macam tu?”

34c6ff2e46c5.en: “For real, though, this is your opportunity to shine as Sanbi-eye! Go out and have fun! A friend said that PTSD is basically the past trying to screw over your future, so try to focus on the future instead!”
34c6ff2e46c5.t: “Serius, ini peluang kau untuk bersinar sebagai Sanbi-eye! Pergi keluar dan berseronok! Seorang kawan kata PTSD pada dasarnya masa lalu yang cuba merosakkan masa depan kau, jadi cuba fokus pada masa depan!”

35d50b4d714c.t: Tiada jawapan yang terlintas di fikiran.

362e3702a983.en: Harry touched his beating heart. “So—you’re saying—I actually died?”
362e3702a983.t: Harry menyentuh jantungnya yang berdegup. “Jadi—makcik nak kata—saya betul-betul mati?”

38c8b46564b1.en: Hiromi, coming back to himself, stood up as food juices, beer, mead, and blood dripped onto the floor. With a straight face, quite literally since his nose flattened, he slowly raised his hand to check his green and red mohawk. Not only was it soaked in all kinds of substances but he felt that part of it also got chopped off. His uneven breath, open wordless mouth, and wide eyes glanced at a sharp weapon on the table. Right by it, he saw the missing piece of his mohawk resting peacefully on the table. If he had an aura that instant, it would have turned bright red and blown up the bar into smithereens, killing everyone around. He began screaming with such horrendous guttural violence that his vocal cords were about to snap. Without hesitation, his bloodshot eyes aimed at the perpetrator, Yacamim. He ran towards Yacamim with a punch, ready to explode her brains out.
38c8b46564b1.t: Hiromi, kembali sedar, berdiri sementara jus makanan, bir, mead dan darah menitis ke lantai. Dengan muka rata, secara harfiah kerana hidungnya penyek, dia perlahan-lahan mengangkat tangannya untuk memeriksa jambul mohawk hijau dan merahnya. Bukan sahaja ia basah dengan pelbagai jenis bahan tetapi dia merasakan sebahagiannya juga terpotong. Nafasnya yang tidak sekata, mulut terbuka tanpa kata, dan mata terbeliak mengerling ke arah senjata tajam di atas meja. Betul-betul di sebelahnya, dia nampak kepingan jambul mohawknya yang hilang terletak dengan aman di atas meja. Jika dia mempunyai aura pada saat itu, ia akan bertukar merah terang dan meletupkan bar itu berkecai, membunuh semua orang di sekeliling. Dia mula menjerit dengan keganasan dari kerongkong yang begitu dahsyat sehingga peti suaranya hampir putus. Tanpa teragak-agak, matanya yang merah menyala membidik pelakunya, Yacamim. Dia berlari ke arah Yacamim dengan penumbuk, bersedia untuk meletupkan otaknya.

38f46f702696.en: With a firm nod, Harry’s mind focused solely on the what-if story—so much so that what just happened with Itanema might have been forgotten already. He took another sip of his nearly finished drink.
38f46f702696.t: Dengan anggukan tegas, fikiran Harry tertumpu sepenuhnya pada cerita bagaimana-jika itu—sehingga apa yang baru berlaku dengan Itanema mungkin sudah dilupakan. Dia menghirup lagi minumannya yang hampir habis.

38ffb8762147.en: Harry nodded, holding the single amethyst tightly in his hand.
38ffb8762147.t: Harry mengangguk, menggenggam erat sebiji amethyst itu di tangannya.

3cbea8e1f4b1.en: Looking at Hiromi, then back at Itanema, Harry flashed a big smile. “Yeah!” A fuzzy, warm feeling was dwelling inside him—or it was the alcohol filling up his belly.
3cbea8e1f4b1.t: Memandang Hiromi, kemudian kembali ke arah Itanema, Harry memancarkan senyuman lebar. “Ha!” Perasaan hangat yang kabur bersarang dalam dirinya—atau itu alkohol yang memenuhi perutnya.

3df59b2fce4b.en: “Can you also help me with my eyesight again too?” Harry carefully stepped down the stairs, aggressively squinting his bad eyes to see a little better.
3df59b2fce4b.t: “Boleh awak tolong saya dengan penglihatan saya lagi juga?” Harry menuruni tangga dengan berhati-hati, mengecilkan matanya yang teruk dengan kuat untuk melihat sedikit lebih baik.

3e104b7a3bc0.en: Sora! Oh no! What if it was her? Harry tried to sit up again, but only his hands complied with the request—until they came crashing down against the comfort of the bed sheets as they grew limp.
3e104b7a3bc0.t: Sora! Alamak! Macam mana kalau dia? Harry cuba duduk lagi, tetapi hanya tangannya yang menurut permintaan itu—sehinggalah ia terhempas semula ke atas keselesaan cadar katil ketika ia menjadi lembik.

3f057585e54b.en: “Good try! Good try! C’mon! Try again!” Hiromi grabbed a dart from Harry’s hand and threw it towards the same green, but it landed far above it in a purple zone. “Aw, my chitin ass! Anyways, the goal is to land on the same color region to score a point. If you land on a region with someone else’s dart, you two cancel each other out. Ehh—right? Right—right. The smaller the region, the more it’s worth when sniping it. That makes sense?”
3f057585e54b.t: “Cubaan yang bagus! Cubaan yang bagus! Ayuh! Cuba lagi!” Hiromi mengambil sebatang dart dari tangan Harry dan membalingnya ke arah hijau yang sama, tetapi ia mendarat jauh di atasnya di zon ungu. “Aduh, bontot kitin aku! Apa-apa pun, matlamatnya ialah mendarat di kawasan warna yang sama untuk dapat mata. Kalau kau mendarat di kawasan yang ada dart orang lain, korang berdua batal antara satu sama lain. Ehh—kan? Kan—kan. Lagi kecil kawasan tu, lagi tinggi nilainya bila tembak. Faham?”

3fefbc621653.en: Takeo politely declined with a slow shake of the head, standing up as he stated monotonously, “We finished the quest. We celebrated. We all spoke our minds. Now we say our goodbyes.”
3fefbc621653.t: Takeo menolak dengan sopan dengan gelengan perlahan, berdiri sambil berkata dengan mendatar, “Kita dah siapkan misi. Kita dah raikan. Kita semua dah luahkan apa yang terbuku. Sekarang kita ucapkan selamat tinggal.”

408420fe9aa7.en: Harry couldn’t help but stare at the badass-looking red and green mohawk. The flashy silvery ear piercings looked really, really cool, too—or an indication that he was a power bottom. Either way, he was a true adventurer; his chitin and leather outfit looked sturdy but not too over-cumbering in its weight. “Y—yeah? That’s me.”
408420fe9aa7.t: Harry tidak dapat menahan diri daripada merenung jambul mohawk merah dan hijau yang kelihatan hebat itu. Tindikan telinga keperakan yang menonjol kelihatan sangat, sangat bergaya juga—atau petanda bahawa dia seorang power bottom. Apa pun, dia seorang pengembara sejati; pakaian kitin dan kulitnya kelihatan kukuh tetapi tidak terlalu membebankan dari segi beratnya. “Y—ya? Saya la tu.”

414c648c9ea8.en: The grandmotherly maid touched Harry’s forehead. “It’s okay, honey. Your body is still recovering. Take your time.”
414c648c9ea8.t: Pembantu rumah seperti nenek itu menyentuh dahi Harry. “Tak apa, nak. Badan kau masih pulih. Ambil masa kau.”

41ae51a51c68.en: Ohhh. This sucks! A sense of being overwhelmed as he tried to stay alive kept going, but it didn’t appear like he was on his last breath—maybe the last ones based on the agony. He tried breathing deeply again, but it didn’t hurt as much this time. He tried to lift his neck again; it was still cumbersome but not as heavy as before. His eyes were no longer sharp, but the blurry ceiling he stared at was familiar. He then turned his head towards the maid, immediately recognizing that he had seen her before when dining with the Sanbi royalty. The clothing reminded him of the other maids, including Sora. That suddenly caused him to catch a glimpse of the dream, or nightmare, or whatever it was, where Sora was washing his back with a massive grin on her noseless and eyeless face.
41ae51a51c68.t: Ohhh. Teruknya! Rasa terbeban ketika dia cuba kekal hidup terus berlanjutan, tetapi ia tidak kelihatan seperti nafas terakhirnya—mungkin nafas-nafas terakhir berdasarkan seksaan itu. Dia cuba bernafas dalam lagi, tetapi tidak sesakit tadi kali ini. Dia cuba mengangkat lehernya lagi; masih susah tetapi tidak seberat tadi. Matanya tidak lagi tajam, tetapi siling kabur yang direnungnya itu biasa. Dia kemudian memalingkan kepalanya ke arah pembantu rumah itu, serta-merta mengecam bahawa dia pernah melihatnya ketika makan bersama kerabat diraja Sanbi. Pakaian itu mengingatkannya kepada pembantu rumah lain, termasuk Sora. Itu tiba-tiba menyebabkannya terimbas mimpi, atau mimpi ngeri, atau apa pun itu, di mana Sora sedang menggosok belakangnya dengan sengihan besar di wajahnya yang tidak berhidung dan tidak bermata.

4271f1081f6d.en: “Or if you want to hear Itagiba’s pep talk—” Eiri chuckled, deepening her voice, and slapping Harry on the shoulder. “Harry, my man!” Eiri grabbed his head from the top with a handful. “You need to get out of your own fucking head! You’re too deep inside! Don’t worry about it!”
4271f1081f6d.t: “Atau kalau kau nak dengar ceramah semangat Itagiba—” Eiri tergelak kecil, mengaraukan suaranya, dan menampar bahu Harry. “Harry, kawan aku!” Eiri memegang kepalanya dari atas dengan segenggam. “Kau kena keluar dari kepala kau sendiri, celaka! Kau dah terlalu dalam! Jangan risau pasal tu!”

42ff5485c3d4.en: Eiri began leading Harry out of the room, pushing his back towards the door. “Let’s get you some water and food then! At least I can help with that!”
42ff5485c3d4.t: Eiri mula membawa Harry keluar dari bilik, menolak belakangnya ke arah pintu. “Jom kita bagi kau air dan makanan kalau macam tu! Sekurang-kurangnya aku boleh tolong dengan tu!”

441e26b31ebc.en: “Aiight. Come here!” Hiromi embraced Harry with a big brotherly hug. “Harry, or should I say Sanbi-eye? I hope you have tons of fun, my brotha! Next time I’m on a quest nearby, I will send you a winga mail for us to meet up!”
441e26b31ebc.t: “Okeylah. Mari sini!” Hiromi memeluk Harry dengan pelukan bersaudara yang besar. “Harry, atau patut aku panggil Sanbi-eye? Harap kau seronok sangat, brader aku! Lain kali aku buat misi berdekatan, aku akan hantar winga mail untuk kita berjumpa!”

453261752d4d.en: Hiromi placed one hand by his mouth while the other raised the jar towards the atrium. He shouted brightly, but still in the same deep, ultimatum-sounding voice, “Come drink with us too! The more, the merrier!”
453261752d4d.t: Hiromi meletakkan sebelah tangan di tepi mulutnya sementara yang lagi satu mengangkat balang ke arah atrium. Dia menjerit dengan ceria, tetapi masih dengan suara yang sama dalam dan berbunyi seperti kata dua, “Mari minum dengan kami juga! Lagi ramai, lagi meriah!”

45f1a1cba5d9.en: “Yea.” A loud womanly voice, slightly gurgly from perhaps taking a big gulp, echoed in the atrium through the half-open door. It was for sure Yacamim.
45f1a1cba5d9.t: “Ha.” Suara wanita yang kuat, sedikit berdeguk mungkin kerana meneguk besar, bergema di atrium melalui pintu yang separuh terbuka. Itu pasti Yacamim.

469b47001d19.en: “YES! That’s how it’s done!” Hiromi let go of the pose and embraced Harry with a friendly, brotherly tight hug. “Glad you came back! Now let’s celebrate life!” Walking behind the bar, he perused around the alcohol cabinet. “Do you remember having lolish-floaters?”
469b47001d19.t: “YA! Macam tu la caranya!” Hiromi melepaskan pose itu dan memeluk Harry dengan pelukan erat yang mesra dan bersaudara. “Seronok kau dah balik! Sekarang jom raikan kehidupan!” Berjalan ke belakang bar, dia meninjau kabinet arak. “Kau ingat pernah minum lolish-floaters?”

475542104620.en: A warm feeling arose in Harry, contrasting that annoying feeling lingering within. “Thanks, Eiri! I guess I will!”
475542104620.t: Perasaan hangat timbul dalam diri Harry, kontras dengan perasaan menjengkelkan yang berlegar di dalam. “Terima kasih, Eiri! Rasanya saya akan buat!”

491dfdd15f1f.en: Chuckling, Hiromi patted Harry on the back. “Just don’t breathe it in. Let it all out first. Good job! Good job!”
491dfdd15f1f.t: Tergelak kecil, Hiromi menepuk belakang Harry. “Jangan sedut je. Keluarkan semua dulu. Bagus! Bagus!”

493b20063ebd.en: Harry looked as if he had just come out of a stampede. “Arrggh—” His brain was overflowing with warnings—like suddenly, his brain stem, commonly known as the body’s autopilot, disengaged. Harry felt like he had to force himself to stay alive consciously. He felt like he was telling his weakened heart to keep pulsating as he manually tried to draw a pained, laborious breath. Amongst the warnings, an accompanying pressure and dull pain surfaced where his bladder was and radiated down to his privates. He tried to bend his neck forward to see better what was happening, but it felt like his head was as heavy as a solid iron ball.
493b20063ebd.t: Harry kelihatan seolah-olah dia baru keluar dari rempuhan kawanan. “Arrggh—” Otaknya melimpah dengan amaran—seolah-olah tiba-tiba, batang otaknya, yang biasa dikenali sebagai juruterbang automatik badan, terputus. Harry merasakan seperti dia terpaksa memaksa dirinya untuk kekal hidup secara sedar. Dia merasakan seperti dia memberitahu jantungnya yang lemah untuk terus berdenyut sambil dia secara manual cuba menarik nafas yang sakit dan payah. Di tengah-tengah amaran itu, tekanan dan sakit tumpul yang mengiringinya muncul di tempat pundi kencingnya berada dan menjalar ke kemaluannya. Dia cuba membengkokkan lehernya ke depan untuk melihat dengan lebih jelas apa yang berlaku, tetapi kepalanya terasa seberat bebola besi padu.

49b4d981b111.en: Hearing a boot clacking towards them, Harry glanced at it and saw a blurry of a maid that felt too familiar. Her unnaturally bright cyan eyes and red lips were unavoidable to look at. Her dark brown hair shone against the sun’s natural light poking through the atrium windows, while her almond skin added a mysterious beauty to her aura. The tight blue corset on top of the black clothing enhanced her natural curviness and the eye-magnet power of her breasts. It was none other than Arukia. The maid that teased him to no end. Does she really like me?
49b4d981b111.t: Mendengar bunyi but berdetak ke arah mereka, Harry mengerling ke arahnya dan nampak kekaburan seorang pembantu rumah yang terasa terlalu biasa. Mata biru kehijauannya yang terang luar biasa dan bibir merahnya mustahil untuk tidak dipandang. Rambut coklat gelapnya bersinar di bawah cahaya semula jadi matahari yang menjengul melalui tingkap atrium, manakala kulitnya yang sawo matang menambahkan kecantikan misteri pada auranya. Korset biru yang ketat di atas pakaian hitam menonjolkan lekuk tubuhnya yang semula jadi dan kuasa buah dadanya yang menarik mata. Dia tidak lain tidak bukan Arukia. Pembantu rumah yang mengusiknya tanpa henti. Dia betul-betul suka aku ke?

4a8e09d255d6.en: Eiri placed the amethyst on her desk. “That explains the bang I heard. Well, it’s not the first time he had to pay for stuff either—but he is the prince, so what can I do? Hmmm, at least he doesn’t wait until I generate an invoice like Itagiba.” Eiri placed her gloved hands on Harry’s shoulder, profoundly looking into his blue eyes. “But doing that wouldn’t cause your mood to swing like this, right? There’s something else you want to tell me about Sora? I already know you have the hots for her.”
4a8e09d255d6.t: Eiri meletakkan amethyst itu di atas mejanya. “Patutlah aku dengar bunyi dentuman. Hah, ini bukan kali pertama dia terpaksa bayar benda pun—tapi dia putera, jadi apa aku boleh buat? Hmmm, sekurang-kurangnya dia tak tunggu sampai aku keluarkan invois macam Itagiba.” Eiri meletakkan tangannya yang bersarung di bahu Harry, memandang dalam-dalam mata birunya. “Tapi buat benda tu takkan buat mood kau berubah macam ni, kan? Ada benda lain yang kau nak bagi tahu aku pasal Sora? Aku dah tahu kau syok kat dia.”

4aae58e9719a.en: A burst of constrained laughter sounded from Eiri at first, but then it died down as she seemed to notice Harry wasn’t laughing. “Hmmmm—are you sure it is not a nightmare? Like a really vivid one? I mean, some would say that’s a wet dream—” A small smirk broke through the corner of Eiri’s mouth.
4aae58e9719a.t: Ledakan ketawa yang tertahan kedengaran dari Eiri pada mulanya, tetapi kemudian ia reda kerana dia nampaknya perasan Harry tidak ketawa. “Hmmmm—kau pasti itu bukan mimpi ngeri? Macam yang betul-betul jelas? Maksud aku, ada orang akan kata itu mimpi basah—” Senyum sinis kecil menembusi sudut mulut Eiri.

4b8ea4c4b749.en: “Pfff—there’s plenty of time! It’s only Sunnohigh! Celebrating life comes first!” Hiromi searched the cabinets down lower, making rustling noses, including a noise akin to opening and closing a chest freezer. “Aww. Yes! There you go! Fresh gyut, and lolish!” He pulled out two small wooden containers. One was filled to the brim with a fruit that looked like cherries but with color hues between red and orange spectrums, while the other was a piece of root that seemed pretty close to ginger. Hiromi checked the shaker Maiara had left behind but then shoved it aside and grabbed a far bigger one from the cabinet—capable of holding enough booze to make a typical human forget everything bad, good, or even life itself. Placing all the gyut berries inside, he grabbed a muddler and muddled the gyut as if they had dishonored his family.
4b8ea4c4b749.t: “Pfff—masih banyak masa! Baru Sunnohigh! Raikan kehidupan dulu!” Hiromi menyelongkar kabinet di bawah, membuat bunyi gemersik, termasuk bunyi seperti membuka dan menutup peti sejuk beku. “Aww. Ya! Ni dia! Gyut segar, dan lolish!” Dia mengeluarkan dua bekas kayu kecil. Satu diisi penuh dengan buah yang kelihatan seperti ceri tetapi dengan warna antara spektrum merah dan jingga, manakala satu lagi sepotong akar yang kelihatan hampir sama dengan halia. Hiromi memeriksa penggoncang yang ditinggalkan Maiara tetapi kemudian menolaknya ke tepi dan mengambil yang jauh lebih besar dari kabinet—mampu menampung arak yang cukup untuk membuatkan manusia biasa melupakan segala yang buruk, baik, malah kehidupan itu sendiri. Meletakkan semua beri gyut ke dalamnya, dia mengambil penumbuk dan menumbuk gyut itu seolah-olah ia telah memalukan keluarganya.

4cd3d093a687.en: “Dunno—” Hiromi placed the balls back in the leather bag and shoved it up his skirt, hiding it somewhere most people wouldn’t dare touch. “But I have more drinking to do, and math ain’t my thing. You know where Eiri is?”
4cd3d093a687.t: “Entah—” Hiromi meletakkan bola-bola itu semula ke dalam beg kulit dan menyumbatnya ke dalam skirtnya, menyembunyikannya di suatu tempat yang kebanyakan orang tidak berani sentuh. “Tapi aku ada banyak lagi nak minum, dan matematik bukan bidang aku. Kau tahu Eiri kat mana?”

502be943c9b9.en: “Brotha—you suck at this—Harry?” Hiromi held Harry; then, his eyes were wide open when he took notice of his paleness. His floppy ears then noticed a dreaded sound of retching coming out of Harry. “Ow, Harry! My brotha! Hold it! Hold it! HOLD IT!” With the same worried voice of a husband telling his wife going to labor to hold it just a few more seconds until they get to the hospital, Hiromi grabbed Harry and began to charge towards the atrium at full speed. Clashing against the door, smacking it wide open, he struck Harry’s head against the wall as he lost his balance; Hiromi didn’t even seem to notice it at first.
502be943c9b9.t: “Brader—kau memang teruk main ni—Harry?” Hiromi memegang Harry; kemudian, matanya terbeliak apabila dia perasan kepucatannya. Telinganya yang terkulai kemudian menangkap bunyi menakutkan orang hendak muntah keluar dari Harry. “Ow, Harry! Brader aku! Tahan! Tahan! TAHAN!” Dengan suara risau yang sama seperti suami yang memberitahu isterinya yang hendak bersalin supaya bertahan beberapa saat lagi sehingga mereka sampai di hospital, Hiromi memegang Harry dan mula meluru ke arah atrium dengan kelajuan penuh. Merempuh pintu, menghentaknya terbuka luas, dia menghantukkan kepala Harry ke dinding kerana hilang keseimbangan; Hiromi tidak kelihatan perasan pun pada mulanya.

504b870496c7.en: Chapter I – What If? · Vol 2 - Lab Soreno · #HusbandOutWorld
504b870496c7.t: Bab I – Bagaimana Jika? · Jilid 2 - Soreno Makmal · #HusbandOutWorld

5347164896c3.en: Feeling an ominous sensation invading his brain as Sora’s vicious grin lingered on his mind, a notoriously familiar sense of having just gulped five energy drinks at once struck him like a train. The wired feeling pushed his body to sit up, but as he groaned to do so, his body just tweaked slightly instead as this eerie feeling kept making his heart pound harder, at least as hard as it could pound. More memories began flashing back to him, including when Sora licked his neck during the check phase of the duel with Maiara. I need to tell Eiri! Harry fought his body to say or do something. His hands did go up a bit but then came back crashing down as he muttered, “H—w—”
5347164896c3.t: Merasakan sensasi yang tidak menyenangkan menceroboh otaknya ketika sengihan ganas Sora berlegar dalam fikirannya, perasaan biasa yang terkenal seperti baru meneguk lima minuman tenaga sekali gus menghentamnya seperti kereta api. Perasaan teruja itu mendorong tubuhnya untuk duduk, tetapi ketika dia mengerang untuk berbuat demikian, tubuhnya hanya bergerak sedikit sebaliknya sementara perasaan ganjil ini terus membuatkan jantungnya berdegup lebih kencang, sekurang-kurangnya sekencang yang mampu. Lebih banyak ingatan mula terimbas kembali kepadanya, termasuk ketika Sora menjilat lehernya semasa fasa pemeriksaan pertarungan dengan Maiara. Aku kena bagi tahu Eiri! Harry melawan tubuhnya untuk mengatakan atau melakukan sesuatu. Tangannya memang naik sedikit tetapi kemudian terhempas semula ketika dia bergumam, “M—n—”

53640946b7c7.en: “Aurora Toleri—sorry. Sanbi. I lived over there for a long time. Pleased to meet you, Harry.” Aurora tipped her red thatch hat with a significant smile—one that enhanced her wrinkles but one that would make you beg to replace your grandmother with her.
53640946b7c7.t: “Aurora Toleri—maaf. Sanbi. Makcik tinggal kat sana lama. Selamat berkenalan, Harry.” Aurora mengangkat sedikit topi jerami merahnya dengan senyuman bermakna—yang menonjolkan kedutannya tetapi yang akan membuatkan kau merayu untuk menggantikan nenek kau dengannya.

53eb02d0624e.en: Trying to surface the memories of the event also brought this anxiety and perturbed feeling alongside it. Harry tried to concentrate on the moment this girl went towards sitting on his face, but the memory seemed floaty, with details merging into one another. “A vicious smile? I’m—not—sure? Maybe long hair? Greenish? Darkish? Or was it short?” The nightmare, or whatever that vivid thing was, where Sora had a similar vicious smile, seemed to be interfering with the memory of the nightly attack as well, making the person who suffocated him appear even more so as an amalgamation of multiple people. “I can’t tell for sure—it’s all blurring together!”
53eb02d0624e.t: Cuba memunculkan ingatan peristiwa itu turut membawa keresahan dan perasaan terganggu bersamanya. Harry cuba menumpukan perhatian pada saat gadis ini bergerak untuk duduk di atas mukanya, tetapi ingatan itu kelihatan terapung-apung, dengan butiran-butiran bercantum antara satu sama lain. “Senyuman ganas? Saya—tak—pasti? Mungkin rambut panjang? Kehijauan? Gelap? Atau pendek?” Mimpi ngeri, atau apa pun benda jelas itu, di mana Sora mempunyai senyuman ganas yang serupa, seakan-akan turut mengganggu ingatan serangan malam itu, membuatkan orang yang melemaskannya kelihatan lebih lagi seperti gabungan beberapa orang. “Saya tak boleh pastikan—semuanya bercampur aduk!”

56709ae305ee.en: “How are you feeling, honey?” A sweet grandmotherly voice spoke softly nearby. Her older gleeful appearance contrasted the wrinkles in her face, giving her a sense of tenured compassionate servitude. Her red thatch hat was just as bright as her cheery appearance, giving her maid-style black-with-blue-accent clothing a unique look as well. Her body had thicker proportions and well-endowed breasts, which she seemed proud of by wearing the same maid clothing as other far younger Sanbi maids. She masterfully crocheted away, waiting for Harry to regain his senses. “Looks like you had a nightmare, hon?” Her eyes noticed a bump on the sheets, coincidentally where Harry’s second brain would be. “Or a good dream?” Her sweet voice didn’t seem to imply anything—more like just treating whatever that bump was as a fact of life.
56709ae305ee.t: “Macam mana rasa, nak?” Suara nenek yang manis bercakap dengan lembut berdekatan. Rupanya yang tua dan riang kontras dengan kedutan di wajahnya, memberikannya rasa pengabdian penuh belas kasihan yang sudah lama berkhidmat. Topi jerami merahnya sama terang dengan rupanya yang ceria, memberikan pakaian gaya pembantu rumah hitam berhias birunya rupa yang unik juga. Tubuhnya lebih berisi dan buah dadanya besar, yang nampaknya dia bangga dengan memakai pakaian pembantu rumah yang sama seperti pembantu rumah Sanbi lain yang jauh lebih muda. Dia mengait dengan mahir, menunggu Harry sedar sepenuhnya. “Nampaknya kau mimpi ngeri, nak?” Matanya perasan satu bonjolan pada cadar, secara kebetulan di tempat otak kedua Harry berada. “Atau mimpi indah?” Suaranya yang manis tidak kelihatan membayangkan apa-apa—lebih seperti sekadar menganggap apa pun bonjolan itu sebagai lumrah kehidupan.

58d5f98fc8e1.en: Oh shit. Harry remained frozen, “Eh—sorry? I-I don’t know. I-I—I just remember waking up a few days ago and—”
58d5f98fc8e1.t: Alamak. Harry kekal membeku, “Eh—maaf? Sa-saya tak tahu. Sa-saya—saya cuma ingat tersedar beberapa hari lepas dan—”

59b5766ce5cf.en: Raising his empty beer mug and shaking it in the air towards an unsuspecting server, Hiromi’s lips longed for more happiness liquid. “Can’t argue with that—well, she ain’t looking towards here, so I’m gonna walk up there instead. Need anything?”
59b5766ce5cf.t: Mengangkat kole birnya yang kosong dan menggoyangkannya di udara ke arah seorang pelayan yang tidak perasan, bibir Hiromi dahagakan lebih banyak cecair kebahagiaan. “Tak boleh bantah tu—hah, dia tak pandang sini, jadi aku pergi sana je la. Perlukan apa-apa?”

5e0e8b1a37e2.en: Hiromi stepped out of the room towards Arukia. His balance seemed slightly off, based on how he propped his hand on the doorframe as he stared Arukia down. “Say that to Yacamim’s face—she’s the next queen, after all.” His voice grew more profound.
5e0e8b1a37e2.t: Hiromi melangkah keluar dari bilik ke arah Arukia. Keseimbangannya kelihatan sedikit tidak stabil, berdasarkan cara dia bertongkat tangan pada bingkai pintu sambil merenung Arukia. “Cakap macam tu depan muka Yacamim—lagipun dia bakal permaisuri.” Suaranya menjadi lebih garau.

5f143d6f9bda.en: With a messy spit take going everywhere, including Hiromi’s armor, Harry’s reddened face seemed lost at what to say amongst the coughing, trying to clear the invading alcohol to stop burning his lungs.
5f143d6f9bda.t: Dengan semburan minuman yang selekeh ke merata tempat, termasuk baju zirah Hiromi, wajah Harry yang memerah kelihatan hilang kata-kata di tengah-tengah batuk, cuba melegakan alkohol yang menceroboh supaya berhenti membakar paru-parunya.

603f0445e50e.en: “Hmmmm—” Eiri pointed at the same ceiling with a smile. “Think of it this way—this ceiling style is more of a Sanbi thing, so it reinforces the point that you were not too far off from here. So who was doing that to you?”
603f0445e50e.t: “Hmmmm—” Eiri menunjuk ke siling yang sama sambil tersenyum. “Fikir macam ni—gaya siling ni lebih kepada gaya Sanbi, jadi ia mengukuhkan hujah yang kau tak berada jauh dari sini. Jadi siapa yang buat macam tu kat kau?”

61d229300a38.en: Ufff. This is really strong. Harry shook his head, trying to take another sip to see if it improved his situation. “I—” he coughed up. “Never seen—” He kept coughing. “—Yacamim before.”
61d229300a38.t: Ufff. Kuat betul ni. Harry menggeleng, cuba menghirup lagi untuk melihat sama ada ia memperbaiki keadaannya. “Sa—” dia terbatuk. “Tak pernah jumpa—” Dia terus terbatuk. “—Yacamim sebelum ni.”

635fff641df7.en: “Feeling better, honey?” The maid touched Harry’s neck and shoulder all over. “How’s your neck feeling?”
635fff641df7.t: “Rasa lebih baik, nak?” Pembantu rumah itu menyentuh leher dan bahu Harry di merata tempat. “Macam mana leher kau?”

63c5b5009d97.en: With his blurry eyes, the board looked more like an avant-garde painting than a dartboard. With the set of colored darts in his hand, there was a feeling of familiarity. “Kinda? Was the board always this big and colored? I thought it was rounded too—” Harry pointed his hand towards the colored squares in the board, almost in reverence to its bright colorfulness. “OH YEAH! The center is worth more, right? Like we’re scoring to—three-sixty. Right? No less or more?” He squinted his eyes at the edge of the board but didn’t see any numbers whatsoever. Wait—Maybe one-eighty?
63c5b5009d97.t: Dengan matanya yang kabur, papan itu lebih kelihatan seperti lukisan avant-garde daripada papan dart. Dengan set dart berwarna di tangannya, ada rasa biasa. “Macam pernah? Papan ni memang besar dan berwarna-warni ke? Saya ingat bulat juga—” Harry menghalakan tangannya ke arah segi empat berwarna di papan, hampir dengan penuh hormat kepada warnanya yang terang. “OH YA! Tengah tu lebih tinggi markahnya, kan? Macam kita kumpul markah sampai—tiga ratus enam puluh. Kan? Tak kurang atau lebih?” Dia mengecilkan matanya ke arah tepi papan tetapi tidak nampak sebarang nombor langsung. Kejap—Mungkin seratus lapan puluh?

66e5bf35ab89.en: Uncaringly walking out of the bar, Yacamim had her back to Hiromi, but his guttural scream gave away his intention. Evading the brain-exploding punch at the last split second, she blocked two more punches from this massive humanoid, ready to tear her limb by limb. Everyone could hear her bones splitting and cracking with each blocking, yet she seemed to swallow the pain with ease.
66e5bf35ab89.t: Berjalan keluar dari bar tanpa peduli, Yacamim membelakangi Hiromi, tetapi jeritan dari kerongkongnya mendedahkan niatnya. Mengelak tumbukan yang boleh meletupkan otak itu pada saat terakhir, dia menahan dua lagi tumbukan dari makhluk berupa manusia yang besar ini, yang bersedia untuk mengoyakkannya anggota demi anggota. Semua orang dapat mendengar tulangnya retak dan patah dengan setiap tahanan, namun dia nampaknya menelan kesakitan itu dengan mudah.

674d871246bd.en: “Are you retarded? I’m Yacamim.” The girl finished pouring herself a bright green drink. Her hair was loose rather than tied in a pigtail. Her blue base cloth with leather overalls clothing seemed close to Maiara’s, but not quite the same. It also looked really pristine, like she had just bought it. Not even caring to make eye contact, Yacamim stuck her finger in the drink, gave it a nice swirl, then sucked it clean before hamming a large gulp down.
674d871246bd.t: “Kau terencat ke? Aku Yacamim.” Gadis itu selesai menuang minuman hijau terang untuk dirinya. Rambutnya dilepaskan dan bukannya diikat ekor kuda. Pakaian asas birunya dengan baju kerja kulit kelihatan hampir sama dengan Maiara, tetapi tidak betul-betul sama. Ia juga kelihatan sangat bersih, seperti dia baru membelinya. Tidak peduli pun untuk bertentang mata, Yacamim mencelupkan jarinya ke dalam minuman itu, mengacaunya dengan baik, kemudian menghisapnya sehingga bersih sebelum meneguk satu tegukan besar.

67a2e0505316.en: Taking a large sip from the jar, Hiromi let out a burp. “I gotta say, from all my traveling around—Sanbi people are always ready to enjoy watching shit going down. Except her! She needs to loosen up a bit, amirite?”
67a2e0505316.t: Menghirup besar dari balang itu, Hiromi bersendawa. “Aku nak cakap, dari semua pengembaraan aku—orang Sanbi sentiasa bersedia untuk seronok tengok benda kecoh berlaku. Kecuali dia! Dia perlu bertenang sikit, betul tak?”

6825c630df98.en: Harry gleaned his blurry eyesight towards the familiar black and blue clothing, trying to recognize the taller girl, or maybe girls, wearing it—at first, it appeared like there were two maids, but then it clicked that it had to be the one and only maid Itanema. Do I even know other people named like that? Eiri! Something else far more pressing came to mind. “OH SHIT! I’m sorry!” Harry tried to chug the rest of his drink, but it spilled down his face and onto his clothes.
6825c630df98.t: Harry mengarahkan penglihatannya yang kabur ke arah pakaian hitam dan biru yang biasa, cuba mengecam gadis yang lebih tinggi, atau mungkin gadis-gadis, yang memakainya—pada mulanya, kelihatan seperti ada dua orang pembantu rumah, tetapi kemudian dia tersedar itu pasti satu-satunya pembantu rumah Itanema. Aku kenal orang lain ke yang nama macam tu? Eiri! Sesuatu yang jauh lebih mendesak terlintas di fikiran. “ALAMAK SIAL! Maaf!” Harry cuba meneguk habis baki minumannya, tetapi ia tertumpah ke mukanya dan ke pakaiannya.

682f2ec04455.en: Harry shook his head, his droopy eyes searching for any other person in the room as his voice gathered its will. “I-I thought I had this dream, but—but now I know that it wasn’t one—I think—ahh—it actually happened. Remember during the duel when Sora mentioned my neck?”
682f2ec04455.t: Harry menggeleng, matanya yang layu mencari orang lain di dalam bilik sementara suaranya mengumpul kemahuan. “Sa-saya ingat saya ada mimpi ni, tapi—tapi sekarang saya tahu ia bukan mimpi—rasanya—ahh—ia betul-betul berlaku. Ingat masa pertarungan bila Sora sebut pasal leher saya?”

689e8fc71e36.en: “We all play at the same time. GO!” Hiromi threw a dart, making it land on another purple. He then kept throwing darts as if his life depended on it; with each throw, sweat began dripping on his forehead.
689e8fc71e36.t: “Kita semua main serentak. MULA!” Hiromi membaling sebatang dart, membuatkannya mendarat di satu lagi ungu. Dia kemudian terus membaling dart seolah-olah nyawanya bergantung padanya; dengan setiap balingan, peluh mula menitis di dahinya.

692e5b4de578.en: “Maybe?” Hiromi finished his drink with a nice chug. “I mean, not everyone can handle your sassiness.” He belly laughed, letting his tusks enhance his wide grin.
692e5b4de578.t: “Mungkin?” Hiromi menghabiskan minumannya dengan satu teguk yang sedap. “Maksud aku, bukan semua orang boleh tahan sikap kurang ajar kau.” Dia ketawa terbahak-bahak, membiarkan taringnya menonjolkan sengihannya yang lebar.

694d4236f9f8.en: “You forgot about the balls currency too?” Hiromi seemed ready to give a brotherly goodbye hug, but perhaps seeing Harry bringing the amethyst ball to his eyes like a kid would pick up a frog off the street and scientifically analyze it, he opened his leather bag again. “I don’t have any sapphires—I don’t think I—oh, there it is!” Hiromi pulled out a single aquamarine, then a few pearls—all the same size, with the same golden metal crust—and brought them closer to Harry’s squinting eyes. “Fifty pearls is one amethyst. Ten amethysts is one aquamarine, and ten aquamarines is one sapphire.”
694d4236f9f8.t: “Kau lupa pasal mata wang bola juga?” Hiromi kelihatan bersedia untuk memberikan pelukan selamat tinggal bersaudara, tetapi mungkin melihat Harry membawa bola amethyst itu ke matanya seperti budak yang mengambil katak dari jalan dan menganalisisnya secara saintifik, dia membuka beg kulitnya sekali lagi. “Aku tak ada sapphire—rasanya aku tak—oh, ni dia!” Hiromi mengeluarkan sebiji aquamarine, kemudian beberapa biji Pearl—semuanya sama saiz, dengan salutan logam emas yang sama—dan mendekatkannya ke mata Harry yang mengecil. “Lima puluh Pearl sama dengan satu amethyst. Sepuluh amethyst sama dengan satu aquamarine, dan sepuluh aquamarine sama dengan satu sapphire.”

69919e34ad54.en: Harry felt like a knife had been shoved into his heart when he saw Arukia’s reaction. He couldn’t do anything but look down as he felt like he wanted to curl up into a ball and disappear out of her sight.
69919e34ad54.t: Harry merasakan seolah-olah pisau telah ditusuk ke jantungnya apabila melihat reaksi Arukia. Dia tidak dapat melakukan apa-apa selain menunduk kerana dia merasa seperti mahu meringkuk menjadi bola dan hilang dari pandangannya.

69c0c1e139cd.en: “We just kept going on the brawl. I thought I had it in the bag, but she quickly learned my body cues, even my fakeouts. For a Naked Bruntos, a female Naked Bruntos, mind ya, her kicks were out of this world!” Hiromi placed his hand on the right of his belly, the upper right region. “She did get one right in my liver that I still remember to this day. She thought I was done for, but that’s when I took the opportunity and charged her with my shoulder.” Hiromi took another sip, taking the time to chew on a few sliced lolish roots. “My memory is foggy after falling on the ground and bashing my head, but I for sure remembered when the room got rowdy when we started making out.” Hiromi grew even redder in the face as he stared into the distance. “I can’t even remember who started it, but yea.”
69c0c1e139cd.t: “Kami terus bergaduh. Aku ingat aku dah pasti menang, tapi dia cepat belajar isyarat badan aku, malah acahan aku. Untuk seorang Naked Bruntos, Naked Bruntos perempuan pula tu, tendangan dia luar biasa!” Hiromi meletakkan tangannya di sebelah kanan perutnya, kawasan kanan atas. “Dia memang kena tepat kat hati aku sekali yang aku masih ingat sampai hari ni. Dia ingat aku dah tamat, tapi masa tulah aku ambil peluang dan rempuh dia dengan bahu aku.” Hiromi menghirup lagi, mengambil masa mengunyah beberapa hirisan akar lolish. “Ingatan aku kabur lepas jatuh ke lantai dan terhantuk kepala, tapi aku memang ingat bila bilik tu jadi riuh bila kami mula bercumbu.” Wajah Hiromi menjadi lebih merah sambil dia merenung jauh. “Aku pun tak ingat siapa yang mula, tapi ha.”

69cb058cc2d5.en: Harry stood up as well. “Ohhhhh!” His legs were wobbly, and the room felt like he was on a boat, but his steps seemed firm enough that he could walk towards Hiromi. “Oookay!” He could feel the booze slouching in his stomach with every step he took.
69cb058cc2d5.t: Harry turut berdiri. “Ohhhhh!” Kakinya goyah, dan bilik itu terasa seperti dia berada di atas perahu, tetapi langkahnya kelihatan cukup teguh untuk dia berjalan ke arah Hiromi. “Okeeey!” Dia dapat merasakan arak berkocak dalam perutnya setiap langkah yang diambilnya.

6aabf1a8e8cd.en: With bright eyes of her own, Eiri, also commonly referred to as king-maid, smiled back at Harry. “How are you feeling, Harry? Or should I say Sanbi-eye?” As she was sitting in her comfortable chair, one of her eyebrows rose as she curiously glanced at the single amethyst ball in his hand. “Hmmm—whatcha got there?”
6aabf1a8e8cd.t: Dengan matanya sendiri yang bersinar, Eiri, juga biasa dipanggil king-maid, membalas senyuman Harry. “Macam mana rasa, Harry? Atau patut aku panggil Sanbi-eye?” Sambil duduk di kerusinya yang selesa, salah satu keningnya terangkat ketika dia mengerling dengan ingin tahu sebiji bola amethyst di tangannya. “Hmmm—apa yang kau pegang tu?”

6b09e8183fc0.en: With a click of the tongue, Arukia clapped back with a sarcastic tone, “That’s not an excuse to blow the door apart!” She stood at where the door was, looking around the bathroom for something, then suddenly her sensual red lips formed a smirk—it appeared as if she was readying herself for a mic drop with the same energy of a rapper about to fire a you-momma joke in a rap duel. She picked a piece of a doorframe from the floor with a partial imprint of a nonhuman-sized foot with clear indents of a spiked boot. “That’s all the proof I need to make you never set foot here again!” She hid the piece behind her, winking at Hiromi as she stepped backward. “I’m sure I can even get him as an accomplice.”
6b09e8183fc0.t: Dengan decitan lidah, Arukia membalas dengan nada menyindir, “Itu bukan alasan untuk letupkan pintu tu!” Dia berdiri di tempat pintu itu dahulu, memandang sekeliling bilik air mencari sesuatu, kemudian tiba-tiba bibir merahnya yang sensual membentuk senyuman sinis—ia kelihatan seolah-olah dia sedang bersedia untuk menjatuhkan mikrofon dengan tenaga yang sama seperti penyanyi rap yang hendak melepaskan jenaka mak kau dalam pertarungan rap. Dia mengambil sekeping bingkai pintu dari lantai dengan kesan sebahagian tapak kaki bersaiz bukan manusia dengan lekukan jelas but berpaku. “Itu saja bukti yang aku perlukan untuk buat kau tak jejakkan kaki kat sini lagi!” Dia menyembunyikan kepingan itu di belakangnya, mengenyitkan mata kepada Hiromi sambil berundur. “Aku pasti aku boleh jadikan dia bersubahat juga.”

6b929ece5188.en: With the somehow still intact muddler set aside, Hiromi went after the lolish root next, pulling out a smaller mandoline slicer from a specific cabinet below without even having to search. The slicer was made out of slightly discolored wood with a steel blade in the center that had seen better days—it looked ready to be retired, but the beautiful green and blue tribal carvings built into it were probably the reason it was still in use.
6b929ece5188.t: Dengan penumbuk yang entah bagaimana masih utuh itu diletakkan ke tepi, Hiromi mengejar akar lolish pula, mengeluarkan alat penghiris mandolin yang lebih kecil dari kabinet tertentu di bawah tanpa perlu mencari pun. Penghiris itu diperbuat daripada kayu yang sedikit pudar warnanya dengan bilah keluli di tengah yang sudah lama tidak dalam keadaan terbaik—ia kelihatan sedia untuk bersara, tetapi ukiran puak hijau dan biru yang cantik yang terbina padanya mungkin sebab ia masih digunakan.

6ca539fb6514.en: “Then bring Eiri down here! We’re having fun, right, Harry?” With a charming but still kinda threatening look, Hiromi looked back at Harry. Perhaps the terrifying part was due to his heavy, warm hand weighing down on Harry’s shoulder like a sack of potatoes.
6ca539fb6514.t: “Kalau macam tu bawa Eiri turun ke sini! Kami tengah berseronok, kan, Harry?” Dengan rupa yang menawan tetapi masih agak mengancam, Hiromi memandang semula Harry. Mungkin bahagian yang menakutkan itu disebabkan tangannya yang berat dan hangat menghempap bahu Harry seperti seguni kentang.

6d2d3e86641c.en: “Me neither, to be honest!” Eiri pursed her lips as she held her arms tightly. “I believe you suffered abuse at some point in your life, probably in the Sanbi slums, before Gabiro did something to your soul. It’s like what they say—painful memories are easier to remember than happier ones, so there’s a chance that you didn’t lose your memories but they are locked away instead because they were too painful! Honestly, I don’t know why someone would do such an unacceptable thing!” Eiri gasped as she seemed to cheer up; she stood up and looked brightly at Harry’s eyes like she had owned the lotto. “That’s it! That’s the ticket to remember where you came from! Do you remember any characteristics of the person? Or exactly where it happened?”
6d2d3e86641c.t: “Aku pun tak tahu, jujurnya!” Eiri memuncungkan bibirnya sambil memeluk tubuh erat-erat. “Aku percaya kau pernah didera pada satu ketika dalam hidup kau, mungkin kat setinggan Sanbi, sebelum Gabiro buat sesuatu pada jiwa kau. Macam yang orang cakap—ingatan yang menyakitkan lebih mudah diingat berbanding yang gembira, jadi ada kemungkinan kau tak hilang ingatan tapi ia terkunci sebab terlalu menyakitkan! Jujurnya, aku tak tahu kenapa seseorang nak buat benda yang tak boleh diterima macam tu!” Eiri tercungap seolah-olah dia menjadi ceria; dia berdiri dan memandang terang ke mata Harry seperti dia baru menang loteri. “Itu dia! Itulah tiket untuk ingat dari mana kau datang! Kau ingat apa-apa ciri orang tu? Atau kat mana tepatnya ia berlaku?”

7027f60219eb.en: As he reddened in the face as well, Harry’s heart didn’t know whether to pound in fear or race in passion. His brain swirled in a mix of emotions as his mouth moved to say something to Sora, but no words came out.
7027f60219eb.t: Sambil wajahnya turut memerah, jantung Harry tidak tahu sama ada mahu berdegup kerana takut atau berlumba kerana ghairah. Otaknya berpusar dalam campuran emosi ketika mulutnya bergerak untuk mengatakan sesuatu kepada Sora, tetapi tiada kata-kata yang keluar.

70cd8a5c7c72.en: “Just leave him be.” Hiromi watched him disappear out of the door. “He didn’t speak his mind, but I guess not saying anything is also saying something?”
70cd8a5c7c72.t: “Biarkan je dia.” Hiromi memerhatinya hilang di sebalik pintu. “Dia tak luahkan apa yang terbuku, tapi rasanya tak cakap apa-apa pun bermakna cakap sesuatu juga?”

716c40ea4afa.en: WAIT! Harry looked at Sora’s cutesy petite body, glancing at her hand, which was moving quickly through an abacus while the other hand was writing down things and her eyes were scouring through lines of a receipt. Was it her? His blurry eyes focused on Sora’s thin lips, comparing it to the vicious grin of the girl suffocating him in his memories. Maybe it had something to do with his lingering buzz, but something suddenly clicked deep in his mind—something isn’t right! The person that did that didn’t have tusks! The red thingy in the arm—yea! Darfaries interface! The person didn’t have that either! It can’t be Sora after all—wait—why did I think it could be her in the first place? Harry kept staring at Sora, his eyes duller than before, as his hands lowered on his own, hiding away the amethyst ball. Then who was it? He openly stared back at Eiri, observing her developing a slightly mischievous smirk; his mind drew blank in an attempt to refuse to believe she was the one.
716c40ea4afa.t: KEJAP! Harry memandang tubuh kecil Sora yang comel, mengerling tangannya, yang bergerak pantas di atas sempoa sementara tangan yang lagi satu sedang menulis dan matanya meneliti baris-baris resit. Dia ke? Matanya yang kabur tertumpu pada bibir nipis Sora, membandingkannya dengan sengihan ganas gadis yang melemaskannya dalam ingatannya. Mungkin ada kaitan dengan khayalnya yang masih berbaki, tetapi sesuatu tiba-tiba terlintas jauh dalam fikirannya—ada sesuatu yang tak kena! Orang yang buat tu tak ada taring! Benda merah kat lengan tu—ha! Antara muka Darfaries! Orang tu tak ada itu juga! Tak mungkin Sora rupanya—kejap—kenapa aku fikir mungkin dia pada mulanya? Harry terus merenung Sora, matanya lebih suram daripada tadi, sementara tangannya turun dengan sendirinya, menyembunyikan bola amethyst itu. Habis tu siapa? Dia merenung terang-terangan kembali ke arah Eiri, memerhatinya mula mengukir senyum sinis yang sedikit nakal; fikirannya menjadi kosong dalam usaha untuk enggan percaya dialah orangnya.

7355b52de6df.en: “Not only did we not make any profit; now we’re wasting personal funds here! We need to be out there!” Kaiana waved outwardly, letting her unnatural gift jiggly around freely.
7355b52de6df.t: “Bukan je kita tak dapat untung; sekarang kita membazir dana peribadi kat sini! Kita perlu berada kat luar sana!” Kaiana melambai ke luar, membiarkan anugerahnya yang luar biasa bergegar dengan bebas.

73b942e75f4f.en: Doing so, Harry felt his throat burn just as much as when the alcohol was going in. He could feel the waves of vomit swelling deep in his gut, powerless to stop it. It felt like the stomach was puppeteering his whole body; all he could do was fight the urge to breathe.
73b942e75f4f.t: Menurut, Harry merasakan kerongkongnya terbakar sama seperti ketika alkohol masuk. Dia dapat merasakan gelombang muntah membengkak jauh di dalam perutnya, tidak berdaya untuk menghentikannya. Ia terasa seperti perut sedang mengawal seluruh tubuhnya seperti boneka; yang mampu dia lakukan hanyalah melawan desakan untuk bernafas.

73ca5d1d2532.en: “And for what end? To have this dead meat drain all my nari stones?” Kaiana slapped hard on the table, making a nice echo in the bar and catching a few glimpses that didn’t seem to care about her babbling—but were interested in her jiggling. She looked towards Takeo with a bitter dammed smile—the kind of smile that a boy will never forget because that’s when they realize they goofed it up and there’s no taking back.
73ca5d1d2532.t: “Dan untuk apa? Untuk biar daging mati ni habiskan semua batu nari aku?” Kaiana menampar meja dengan kuat, membuatkan gema yang sedap di bar dan menarik beberapa jelingan yang tidak peduli tentang bebelannya—tetapi berminat dengan gegarannya. Dia memandang ke arah Takeo dengan senyuman pahit yang terpendam—jenis senyuman yang tidak akan dilupakan oleh seorang budak lelaki kerana ketika itulah mereka sedar mereka sudah tersilap dan tiada jalan untuk berpatah balik.

75d376e17b6f.en: With this opening, Hiromi then punched squarely on Yacamim’s face, throwing her backward. “Not bad for a human girl!” He made a low, hoarse belly laugh as he saw Yacamim splattered on the floor with a flattened nose just like his.
75d376e17b6f.t: Dengan peluang ini, Hiromi kemudian menumbuk tepat ke muka Yacamim, menghumbannya ke belakang. “Boleh tahan untuk budak perempuan manusia!” Dia ketawa rendah dan serak dari perut ketika melihat Yacamim terkapar di lantai dengan hidung penyek sama seperti hidungnya.

797dff9efe68.en: “Yea. You can take that to your soul death.” Hiromi clacked his jar on Harry’s glass. “But anyways, you want to hear the end?”
797dff9efe68.t: “Ha. Kau boleh pegang tu sampai mati jiwa kau.” Hiromi melagakan balangnya dengan gelas Harry. “Tapi apa-apa pun, kau nak dengar penghujungnya?”

7b88a2b56597.en: The caring eyes of this older maid looked up to the ceiling in search of an answer. “Today is Tollday—oh! She’s getting caught up with paperwork with Sora.”
7b88a2b56597.t: Mata penyayang pembantu rumah tua ini mendongak ke siling mencari jawapan. “Hari ni Tollday—oh! Dia tengah siapkan kertas kerja dengan Sora.”

7c99ab10a343.en: Homeegg? Huh—interesting. Harry did as told, but now he no longer had the same belly as before, so there was so much puffing out he could do.
7c99ab10a343.t: Homeegg? Hah—menarik. Harry menurut, tetapi kini dia tidak lagi mempunyai perut yang sama seperti dahulu, jadi tidak banyak yang boleh dibusungkannya.

7ee8a1f3a494.en: With a hearty amount of booze in his hand, Harry brought it close to his nose. The smell of something akin to gin mixed with vodka was strong, but it went along nicely with the fruit’s tropical, tart, sweet smell. Meanwhile, the gingery aroma of the lolish kinda went along with the rest—like the ginger that comes with sushi. Although, usually, those are a palate cleanser between shoving sushi into your gullet, not part of the experience per se. Cheering with Hiromi, he brought the drink to his mouth and sipped. OH FUCK! Harry’s mouth felt like it was on fire, and the source of the fire was now invading his throat, choking him. His breath felt like he was inhaling ghost peppers.
7ee8a1f3a494.t: Dengan sejumlah besar arak di tangannya, Harry mendekatkannya ke hidung. Bau sesuatu seperti gin bercampur vodka sangat kuat, tetapi ia sesuai dengan bau tropika, masam dan manis buah itu. Sementara itu, aroma halia lolish agak sesuai dengan yang lain—seperti halia yang datang bersama sushi. Walaupun, biasanya, itu untuk membersihkan lelangit di antara menyumbat sushi ke kerongkong kau, bukan sebahagian daripada pengalaman itu sendiri. Bersulang dengan Hiromi, dia membawa minuman itu ke mulutnya dan menghirup. OH CELAKA! Mulut Harry terasa seperti terbakar, dan sumber api itu kini menceroboh kerongkongnya, mencekiknya. Nafasnya terasa seperti dia menyedut cili hantu.

7f1d2478f476.en: Doing as told, Harry used all of his strength to launch the dart, but his hand held it for too long, making the dart fly towards the wall and lodging itself below the dart board. Harry’s body almost fell forward, but he caught himself on his knees and held it there for a bit as the feeling of falling forward kept happening.
7f1d2478f476.t: Menurut, Harry menggunakan sepenuh tenaganya untuk melancarkan dart itu, tetapi tangannya memegangnya terlalu lama, membuatkan dart itu terbang ke dinding dan tertancap di bawah papan dart. Tubuh Harry hampir jatuh ke depan, tetapi dia menahan dirinya pada lututnya dan bertahan di situ seketika sementara perasaan jatuh ke depan terus berlaku.

7f3083611fd0.en: Vol 2 Chapter I subchapter 6: Harry grins at the blonde girl and the red-haired maid at a shop counter, with dresses on mannequins behind.
7f3083611fd0.t: Jilid 2 Bab I subbab 6: Harry tersengih kepada gadis berambut perang dan pembantu rumah berambut merah di kaunter kedai, dengan gaun-gaun pada mannequin di belakang.

7f7e090b255e.en: Harry smiled softly as his head rested on her warm shoulder. “Thanks, Eiri! I don’t know either, but once in a while, I have this thing inside me that makes me feel like my heart is about to explode if I don’t do something about it. But I just don’t know what to do!”
7f7e090b255e.t: Harry tersenyum lembut sambil kepalanya melentok di bahunya yang hangat. “Terima kasih, Eiri! Saya pun tak tahu, tapi sekali-sekala, saya ada benda dalam diri saya ni yang buat saya rasa macam jantung saya nak meletup kalau saya tak buat sesuatu. Tapi saya tak tahu apa nak buat!”

8062c0d26aea.en: Meanwhile, Harry remained sitting, silently appreciating the showmanship displayed as Hiromi finished swinging the shaker widely, then not so masterfully poured the contents into two glass containers—a mug that would get you drunk and a jar that would put you in a coffin. Finally, he tried to pick up the sliced lolish roots with his big fingers, but they kept slipping through—the table and his hands were soaked in booze.
8062c0d26aea.t: Sementara itu, Harry terus duduk, menghargai dalam diam pertunjukan kemahiran yang dipamerkan ketika Hiromi selesai menghayun penggoncang itu dengan luas, kemudian menuang isinya dengan tidak berapa mahir ke dalam dua bekas kaca—sebiji kole yang akan buat kau mabuk dan sebiji balang yang akan memasukkan kau ke dalam keranda. Akhir sekali, dia cuba mengambil hirisan akar lolish dengan jari besarnya, tetapi ia terus tergelincir—meja dan tangannya basah dengan arak.

821a7e56eea3.en: With his hands up and feet spread apart, the humanoid mountain of muscle began approaching him and spreading his feet even more apart in an attempt to level the plane field—as in trying to touch belly to belly, hand to hand. He then stared at Harry’s eyes with a display of willpower that looked like he was about to declare, DESTROY ALL HUMANS!
821a7e56eea3.t: Dengan tangannya diangkat dan kakinya terbuka, gunung otot berupa manusia itu mula mendekatinya dan membuka kakinya lebih luas dalam usaha menyamakan aras—iaitu cuba bersentuhan perut ke perut, tangan ke tangan. Dia kemudian merenung mata Harry dengan pameran kekuatan kemahuan yang kelihatan seperti dia hendak mengisytiharkan, MUSNAHKAN SEMUA MANUSIA!

826d9a8b25b3.en: Arukia tilted her head up to look at Hiromi; his cheeks and ears were plump and red, but his eyes, mouth, and even tusks looked ready to throw down. With a huff from his nose, Hiromi looked downright threatening—like she was staring at a bull ready to charge. Arukia did another click of her tongue as her eyes rolled back in her head. With her free hand, she waved Hiromi off. “That’s the best you got? You and Yacamim are barely here—why would they hand you the monarchy department?” Pointing back to the parlor, she drilled her finale statement with a gotcha smile, “You only show up because of the open bar!” She then pointed at a boxy contraption resting above Harry. “Get him some soap!”
826d9a8b25b3.t: Arukia mendongak untuk memandang Hiromi; pipi dan telinganya tembam dan merah, tetapi mata, mulut, malah taringnya kelihatan bersedia untuk bergaduh. Dengan dengusan dari hidungnya, Hiromi kelihatan benar-benar mengancam—seperti dia sedang merenung seekor lembu jantan yang bersedia untuk merempuh. Arukia mendecit lidahnya sekali lagi sambil matanya menjuling ke belakang kepalanya. Dengan tangannya yang bebas, dia mengibas Hiromi. “Itu je yang kau ada? Kau dan Yacamim jarang ada kat sini—kenapa mereka nak serahkan jabatan monarki kat korang?” Menunjuk semula ke arah ruang tamu, dia menikam kenyataan penamatnya dengan senyuman kena kau, “Kau datang cuma sebab bar percuma!” Dia kemudian menunjuk ke arah alat berbentuk kotak yang terletak di atas Harry. “Ambilkan dia sabun!”

844aca4f77af.en: “Why do you expect me to be all happy and shit about this?” Kaiana spoke up gratingly, waiting for an answer as she sipped her beer. She was a woman of minor port gifted with cutesy, youthful attributes and spirited energy, somehow endowed by disproportionately large breasts that attracted attention whenever she went—or known as Oppai Loli for the cultured ones.
844aca4f77af.t: “Kenapa kau harap aku gembira dan segala benda celaka tu pasal ni?” Kaiana bersuara dengan kasar, menunggu jawapan sambil menghirup birnya. Dia seorang wanita bertubuh kecil yang dikurniakan ciri-ciri comel dan muda serta tenaga yang bersemangat, entah bagaimana dikurniakan buah dada yang besar tidak seimbang yang menarik perhatian ke mana sahaja dia pergi—atau dikenali sebagai Oppai Loli oleh mereka yang berbudaya.

846e98f11e19.en: “I’m not hungry.” Kaiana stood up, adjusting her large wizard-like white-with-black-and-red-accents hat, then her alluring tight-fitting color-coordinated clothing that revealed her slender belly with a perfect belly button. “Thanks for the beer, Hiromi! Send me a winga mail if you do find someone that doesn’t suck as much! I will do the same if I come across a decent party.”
846e98f11e19.t: “Aku tak lapar.” Kaiana berdiri, membetulkan topi besar seperti ahli sihir berwarna putih dengan hiasan hitam dan merah, kemudian pakaiannya yang ketat dan menggoda dengan warna yang sepadan yang mendedahkan perutnya yang ramping dengan pusat yang sempurna. “Terima kasih untuk bir, Hiromi! Hantar winga mail kalau kau jumpa seseorang yang tak teruk sangat! Aku pun akan buat benda yang sama kalau aku jumpa kumpulan yang elok.”

8760cd588ad5.en: “That’s the spirit!” Finishing his massive booze jar with one gigantic gulp, Hiromi stuck it hard on the table, then stood up and stumbled towards the bags of different colored darts hanging on a nearby wall.
8760cd588ad5.t: “Macam tu la semangatnya!” Menghabiskan balang araknya yang besar dengan satu tegukan gergasi, Hiromi menghentaknya kuat ke atas meja, kemudian berdiri dan terhuyung-hayang ke arah beg-beg dart pelbagai warna yang tergantung di dinding berdekatan.

8762e23e0ecd.en: “You already have Yacamim!” With a reddening face, Arukia put the piece of the door she held in front of her, then threw it at Hiromi’s feet as she backed away, her hands holding her chest.
8762e23e0ecd.t: “Kau dah ada Yacamim!” Dengan wajah memerah, Arukia meletakkan kepingan pintu yang dipegangnya di hadapannya, kemudian mencampakkannya ke kaki Hiromi sambil berundur, tangannya memegang dadanya.

878207899072.en: “Might as well eat my fill.” Hiromi walked with his empty mug towards the bar when his eyes caught a glimpse of a well-built guy with fantastic long, voluptuous blackish purple hair. He gawked at his shining hair, touching his own perfectly cared-for mohawk to compare. “BROTHA! YOUR HAIR IS AMAZING!” He grabbed this guy’s shoulder as he rested his body against the wooden countertop, clacking his chitin armor. “What do you—OHH NO!” Hiromi’s pupils flared up, realizing his grave mistake.
878207899072.t: “Baik aku makan puas-puas.” Hiromi berjalan dengan kole kosongnya ke arah bar apabila matanya ternampak seorang lelaki bertubuh tegap dengan rambut ungu kehitaman panjang yang lebat dan hebat. Dia ternganga melihat rambutnya yang berkilat, menyentuh jambul mohawknya sendiri yang dijaga dengan sempurna untuk dibandingkan. “BRADER! RAMBUT KAU MEMANG MANTAP!” Dia memegang bahu lelaki itu sambil menyandarkan tubuhnya pada kaunter kayu, berdetak baju zirah kitinnya. “Apa yang kau—OHH TIDAK!” Anak mata Hiromi membesar, menyedari kesilapan besarnya.

88107cfc344d.en: Next in line was a specific bottle containing a clear white spirit Hiromi grabbed from the alcohol cabinet behind him—it had a small handwritten label hanging from the side, looking like it was either a small batch or homemade production. Pouring the whole thing into the shaker, he gave a silent sign to Harry as he placed the empty bottle back on the cabinet; he grabbed another clear white spirit that looked similar and kept pouring until the shaker was overflowing. He tightly capped it with the strainer and cap, and then began to shake the shit out of it with ultrawide motions that would for sure make an ordinary person strain—if his hands slipped up at any point, booze and fruit flesh would have painted the walls, floor, and ceiling of the parlor. One could safely presume it would cause enough grief for Eiri to snap, flip her shit, and cut Hiromi’s balls off.
88107cfc344d.t: Seterusnya ialah sebotol khusus berisi arak putih jernih yang Hiromi ambil dari kabinet arak di belakangnya—ia mempunyai label kecil tulisan tangan yang tergantung di sisi, kelihatan seperti pengeluaran kelompok kecil atau buatan sendiri. Menuang semuanya ke dalam penggoncang, dia memberi isyarat senyap kepada Harry sambil meletakkan botol kosong itu semula di kabinet; dia mengambil satu lagi arak putih jernih yang kelihatan serupa dan terus menuang sehingga penggoncang itu melimpah. Dia menutupnya rapat dengan penapis dan penutup, dan kemudian mula menggoncangnya habis-habisan dengan gerakan yang amat luas yang pasti akan membuatkan orang biasa tegang—jika tangannya tergelincir pada bila-bila masa, arak dan isi buah akan mengecat dinding, lantai dan siling ruang tamu itu. Boleh diandaikan dengan selamat ia akan menyebabkan cukup kesusahan untuk Eiri naik angin, mengamuk, dan memotong telur Hiromi.

8b332d786fe9.en: Harry let out a phlegm that looked like a slime you would fight in a JRPG game—if you looked closely, you could almost see it coming alive and awaiting its turn to attack. With narrow eyes and curled-up lips, Harry felt a wave of gagging coming in the distance in response to the foul salty taste, but the sensation of being able to breathe freely counterbalanced it.
8b332d786fe9.t: Harry meludahkan kahak yang kelihatan seperti slime yang kau lawan dalam permainan JRPG—jika kau melihat dengan teliti, kau hampir dapat melihatnya hidup dan menunggu gilirannya untuk menyerang. Dengan mata mengecil dan bibir mencebik, Harry merasakan gelombang rasa nak muntah datang di kejauhan sebagai tindak balas kepada rasa masin yang busuk itu, tetapi sensasi dapat bernafas dengan bebas mengimbanginya.

8b48bd5ee1bd.en: “Oh, hon! Don’t struggle so much! I’m here for you.” With dull eyes and a downturned smile, the maid looked at Harry’s labored, pained breath, like he had been forced to run a marathon at gunpoint.
8b48bd5ee1bd.t: “Oh, nak! Jangan meronta sangat! Makcik ada kat sini untuk kau.” Dengan mata suram dan senyuman yang menurun, pembantu rumah itu memandang nafas Harry yang payah dan sakit, seperti dia telah dipaksa berlari maraton di bawah ancaman senapang.

8c07f5970243.en: “So, that’s him, huh?” Yacamim measured Harry, pouring the leftovers from her shaker into the glass—most of it at least, as she seemed too buzzed to care, or she’s not the type to care about it to begin with. Letting out a single long, wet inwardly burp, she began walking away in a mostly straight line. “No wonder sis whooped his ass.” She tonelessly but loudly spoke to herself on her way out.
8c07f5970243.t: “Jadi, itulah dia, ya?” Yacamim menilai Harry, menuang baki dari penggoncangnya ke dalam gelas—sebahagian besarnya sekurang-kurangnya, kerana dia kelihatan terlalu khayal untuk peduli, atau dia memang bukan jenis yang peduli pun. Mengeluarkan satu sendawa panjang dan basah ke dalam, dia mula berjalan pergi dalam garis yang kebanyakannya lurus. “Patutlah kakak belasah dia.” Dia bercakap sendirian dengan mendatar tetapi kuat dalam perjalanan keluar.

8f2eba6bc625.en: No answer from Yacamim. At least not verbally; a single flip of the bird raised on her hand as she took another sip of her drink, going out of sight.
8f2eba6bc625.t: Tiada jawapan dari Yacamim. Sekurang-kurangnya bukan secara lisan; satu jari tengah diangkat di tangannya ketika dia menghirup lagi minumannya, hilang dari pandangan.

90b037be3df7.en: Yacamim lost her balance, possibly a combination of booze and assuming that this colorful-looking adventurer was a mongoloid beast.
90b037be3df7.t: Yacamim hilang keseimbangan, mungkin gabungan arak dan menyangka pengembara yang berwarna-warni ini binatang dungu.

9172a82be699.en: “During the past days.” The grandmotherly maid spoke from the bathroom, raising her voice above the angry gushing water as she cleaned the phlegm-filled pot.
9172a82be699.t: “Sepanjang beberapa hari lepas.” Pembantu rumah seperti nenek itu bercakap dari bilik mandi, meninggikan suaranya mengatasi curahan air marah sambil mencuci periuk yang penuh kahak itu.

920d9c840917.en: Harry could nearly see Itagiba apparating in front of him. I—guess so? A chuckle of his own broke through the ominous feeling stirring in his chest. I have to enjoy this Sanbi-eye thing.
920d9c840917.t: Harry hampir dapat melihat Itagiba menjelma di hadapannya. Ra—rasanya betul? Ketawa kecilnya sendiri menembusi perasaan tidak menyenangkan yang berkocak di dadanya. Aku kena nikmati benda Sanbi-eye ni.

928a9da61f22.en: Harry slowly opened his eyes to the blinding light of a sunny day. His head, then his upper body, felt a gust of humid breeze pass by.
928a9da61f22.t: Harry perlahan-lahan membuka matanya kepada cahaya menyilaukan hari yang cerah. Kepalanya, kemudian bahagian atas tubuhnya, merasakan tiupan bayu lembap berlalu.

9352b5b813ca.en: Feeling like he was breathing fire, Harry felt his body shiver as everything came out from up top in a powerful stream that looked like a geyser from a fire hydrant. Amongst the material things being ejected from his body, Harry felt the voidness and loneliness energy within him being purged out as well. Everything was being violently purged—perhaps alcohol is the interface for soul healing, or it is a temporary placebo before the cruel reality resurfaces when sobriety hits.
9352b5b813ca.t: Merasakan seperti dia menghembus api, Harry merasakan tubuhnya menggigil ketika segala-galanya keluar dari atas dalam aliran kuat yang kelihatan seperti pancutan air dari pili bomba. Di antara benda-benda material yang dikeluarkan dari tubuhnya, Harry merasakan tenaga kekosongan dan kesunyian dalam dirinya turut disingkirkan. Segala-galanya disingkirkan dengan ganas—mungkin alkohol ialah antara muka untuk penyembuhan jiwa, atau ia plasebo sementara sebelum realiti yang kejam muncul semula apabila kesedaran kembali.
