95416ecc5eda.en: Harry cackled, raising the glass to cheer. “I never thought it that way!” A rush tickled his insides—or it was his stomach giving a warning.
95416ecc5eda.t: Harry terkekeh, mengangkat gelas untuk bersulang. “Saya tak pernah fikir macam tu!” Satu debaran menggeletek isi perutnya—atau itu perutnya yang memberi amaran.

97117e80a825.en: “YOU’RE NOT A DUDE!” Hiromi blurted out in a panicked voice, for sure getting caught up as to why the room was so tensed up.
97117e80a825.t: “KAU BUKAN LELAKI!” Hiromi terlepas cakap dengan suara panik, pasti tersedar mengapa bilik itu begitu tegang.

97b5bfbc6c3f.en: Harry groaned as if he was losing the battle. The groans and gags coming out of his mouth sounded worse than a dreaded cat gag EDM drum beat waking you up in the middle of the night. He didn’t even know where he was anymore as he only felt a constant rush of the atrium scenery spin around him as the vomit was pressuring the back of his throat.
97b5bfbc6c3f.t: Harry mengerang seolah-olah dia kalah dalam pertempuran. Erangan dan bunyi nak muntah yang keluar dari mulutnya kedengaran lebih teruk daripada rentak dram EDM kucing nak muntah yang menakutkan yang mengejutkan kau di tengah malam. Dia tidak tahu lagi di mana dia berada kerana dia hanya merasakan pemandangan atrium yang terus berpusing di sekelilingnya sementara muntah menekan belakang kerongkongnya.

9855eb463310.en: “Aiight. Harry, my man, pleased to meet ya!” The massive man stood up and looked down at Harry, not in a threatening manner, but rather literally, as he was almost as tall as a skyscraper. He opened both hands, then raised them high up in the air. Spreading his feet apart to lower his height, he puffed his stomach towards Harry. “Come here, brotha!” It sounded like an ultimatum, not because of the cherry tone but because it was this brute of a man just speaking up.
9855eb463310.t: “Okeylah. Harry, kawan aku, selamat berkenalan!” Lelaki besar itu berdiri dan memandang ke bawah ke arah Harry, bukan dengan cara mengancam, tetapi secara harfiah, kerana dia hampir setinggi bangunan pencakar langit. Dia membuka kedua-dua tangannya, kemudian mengangkatnya tinggi ke udara. Membuka kakinya untuk merendahkan ketinggiannya, dia membusungkan perutnya ke arah Harry. “Mari sini, brader!” Ia kedengaran seperti kata dua, bukan kerana nadanya yang ceria tetapi kerana lelaki yang garang ini yang bersuara.

99f4bf784cbe.en: Grabbing two handfuls of metallic darts with colored feathers on the back, Hiromi handed red with blue darts to Harry and kept yellow with white for himself. “You played this before, right?”
99f4bf784cbe.t: Mengambil dua genggam dart logam dengan bulu berwarna di belakang, Hiromi menghulurkan dart merah dan biru kepada Harry dan menyimpan kuning dan putih untuk dirinya. “Kau pernah main ni, kan?”

9a7a92d54c2f.en: Vol 2 Chapter I subchapter 3: a tavern scene with the mohawked giant, a woman in white and an armored man around a table.
9a7a92d54c2f.t: Jilid 2 Bab I subbab 3: adegan kedai minum dengan gergasi berjambul mohawk, seorang wanita berbaju putih dan seorang lelaki berperisai di sekeliling meja.

9cc1ea882f18.en: Harry felt this cuddly warmth coming from this beastly humanoid. His breath smelled strongly of ginger, with a tangy tropical twist, while his armpits developed a strong manly musk that would keep many people at bay. However, Harry was too happy to care for that, so he hugged him back just as tightly. “Thanks, Hiromi! Brotha!”
9cc1ea882f18.t: Harry merasakan kehangatan yang memeluk mesra datang dari makhluk berupa manusia yang seperti binatang ini. Nafasnya berbau halia yang kuat, dengan sentuhan tropika yang masam, manakala ketiaknya membentuk kasturi jantan yang kuat yang akan menjauhkan ramai orang. Namun, Harry terlalu gembira untuk peduli, jadi dia memeluknya balik sama eratnya. “Terima kasih, Hiromi! Brader!”

a140667cac27.en: “So, the door cost one amethyst?” Harry looked towards the pieces of door scattered on the bathroom floor.
a140667cac27.t: “Jadi, pintu tu harganya satu amethyst?” Harry memandang ke arah kepingan pintu yang bersepah di lantai bilik air.

a17c6329ab28.en: Eiri let go of Harry, firmly holding him by the shoulders, then caressing his head. “That’s PTSD right there! I heard something similar from a friend who cared for an older adventurer too. His whole party got wiped out by a massive walking flathead when they pushed too far into the depths of Bahyum Castle. He would start sobbing uncontrollably out of nowhere, sometimes even trying to kill himself, or get naked and run around screaming from the top of his lungs.” Eiri pointed towards the portrait on the wall of someone who looked awfully close to her. “I bet it is not easy to deal with that, but Mom always said to make life your bitch, not the other way around. Hmmm—so make life your bitch and have it choke on your little thing instead?” A chuckle came out of Eiri as she pinched Harry in the side of his gut.
a17c6329ab28.t: Eiri melepaskan Harry, memegangnya erat di bahu, kemudian membelai kepalanya. “Itulah PTSD! Aku pernah dengar benda yang serupa dari seorang kawan yang jaga seorang pengembara tua juga. Seluruh kumpulannya musnah oleh seekor flathead berjalan yang besar bila mereka mara terlalu jauh ke dalam Istana Bahyum. Dia akan mula teresak-esak tak terkawal tiba-tiba, kadang-kadang siap cuba bunuh diri, atau berbogel dan berlari sambil menjerit sekuat hati.” Eiri menunjuk ke arah potret di dinding seseorang yang kelihatan amat serupa dengannya. “Aku pasti tak mudah nak hadapi semua tu, tapi mak selalu cakap jadikan hidup ni hamba kau, bukan sebaliknya. Hmmm—jadi jadikan hidup hamba kau dan biar ia tercekik benda kecik kau?” Ketawa kecil keluar dari Eiri sambil dia mencubit Harry di tepi perutnya.

a26eeef3c631.en: “STAY WITH ME!” screamed Hiromi as he kicked down the bathroom door square in the middle, making a loud boom that sounded like a grenade going off.
a26eeef3c631.t: “BERTAHAN DENGAN AKU!” jerit Hiromi sambil menendang pintu bilik air tepat di tengah, membuatkan dentuman kuat yang kedengaran seperti bom tangan meletup.

a27745b87c90.en: “I can’t bear this anymore.” The maid spoke under her breath, putting her crochet kit back in the thatch bag and pulling out a vial about the size of a shot glass with a cork holding back a black goo filled to the brim. She brought it closer to Harry’s lips, apparently awaiting him to open his mouth. “Please don’t tell anyone about it, hon! Eiri told me to do it without anyone seeing it.”
a27745b87c90.t: “Makcik dah tak sanggup tengok lagi.” Pembantu rumah itu bercakap perlahan, menyimpan semula set mengaitnya dalam beg jerami dan mengeluarkan sebotol kecil kira-kira sebesar gelas kecil dengan gabus menahan lendir hitam yang diisi penuh hingga ke bibir. Dia mendekatkannya ke bibir Harry, nampaknya menunggu dia membuka mulut. “Tolong jangan bagi tahu sesiapa, nak! Eiri suruh makcik buat tanpa dilihat sesiapa.”

a27de040cb15.en: With his mouth open, Harry tried to imagine the scene of two people with bloody flattened noses making out—something about it lacked the amorousness of a kissing scene, although it definitely must have been passionate in its own twisted ways.
a27de040cb15.t: Dengan mulut ternganga, Harry cuba membayangkan adegan dua orang dengan hidung penyek berdarah bercumbu—ada sesuatu tentangnya yang kurang keasmaraan adegan bercium, walaupun pastinya ia penuh ghairah dengan caranya tersendiri yang terpesong.

a409a9d6c84e.en: Harry made his way into Sanbi Castle, walking into a familiar mix of a parlor and game room located on the southeast corner. “Maiara?” Harry blurted out, looking at a blurry image of a girl that had to be Maiara—or Itagiba dressed in drag. It was kinda hard to tell.
a409a9d6c84e.t: Harry masuk ke Istana Sanbi, berjalan ke campuran ruang tamu dan bilik permainan yang biasa yang terletak di sudut tenggara. “Maiara?” Harry terlepas cakap, memandang imej kabur seorang gadis yang pasti Maiara—atau Itagiba yang berpakaian wanita. Agak sukar untuk dipastikan.

a4649814be73.en: Except, no alarm rang for Harry. This wired feeling slowly dissipated as his memories kept churning in his brain, taking away from the fact that he was somehow still alive despite having a heart attack at some point. Maybe that was the nightmare, and this is my reality? Wait. But then why stuff still feels weird here? Harry looked at his moist eyes and pale face.
a4649814be73.t: Namun, tiada penggera yang berbunyi untuk Harry. Perasaan teruja ini perlahan-lahan hilang ketika ingatannya terus berpusar dalam otaknya, mengalihkan perhatian dari hakikat bahawa dia entah bagaimana masih hidup walaupun pernah diserang sakit jantung pada satu ketika. Mungkin itu mimpi ngeri, dan ini realiti aku? Kejap. Tapi kenapa benda-benda masih terasa pelik kat sini? Harry memandang matanya yang lembap dan wajahnya yang pucat.

a8dd7f8472a2.en: Hiromi pushed the handle, stopping the gush of angry water. A relieved sigh came out of him as he patted Harry on the head, shuffling his short black hair. “Harry—my brotha, good job!”
a8dd7f8472a2.t: Hiromi menolak pemegang itu, menghentikan curahan air yang marah. Keluhan lega keluar daripadanya sambil dia menepuk kepala Harry, mengusutkan rambut hitam pendeknya. “Harry—brader aku, bagus!”

a90f3d019674.en: “Ow, fuck off with that!” Kaiana took a sip of her drink. “You’re the one who introduced him to the team anyways. Do you have someone else that doesn’t suck as much?”
a90f3d019674.t: “Eh, sudahlah dengan benda tu!” Kaiana menghirup minumannya. “Kau yang kenalkan dia kepada pasukan pun. Kau ada orang lain yang tak teruk sangat?”

aa14b99f0fc6.en: I didn’t know that, but I guess it makes sense. Somehow the oldest kid rising to the throne feels like something I learned somewhere—but where? School? Did I go to school? Harry meanwhile washed his face in the cold water in the sink when he felt something touching him. It was Hiromi dumping a whole bunch of flakes of something in his hand that melted into soapy bubbles. He brought it closer to his nose, and it smelled like mint. Wasn’t it supposed to be like a bar or something? He scrubbed it on his face, feeling its soapiness aromatically soapy.
aa14b99f0fc6.t: Aku tak tahu pula, tapi rasanya masuk akal. Entah macam mana anak sulung naik takhta terasa macam sesuatu yang aku belajar kat mana-mana—tapi kat mana? Sekolah? Aku pernah pergi sekolah ke? Harry sementara itu mencuci mukanya dengan air sejuk di sinki apabila dia merasakan sesuatu menyentuhnya. Hiromi sedang melambakkan sejumlah besar kepingan sesuatu ke tangannya yang cair menjadi buih sabun. Dia mendekatkannya ke hidung, dan ia berbau pudina. Bukan ke sepatutnya macam sebuku atau apa? Dia menggosoknya ke mukanya, merasakan kesabunannya yang wangi bersabun.

abce0a58d9f7.en: “Go ask her then.” Itanema turned around and returned to the atrium, closing the door behind her. “Bring him with you.”
abce0a58d9f7.t: “Pergilah tanya dia kalau macam tu.” Itanema berpaling dan kembali ke atrium, menutup pintu di belakangnya. “Bawa dia sekali.”

ac18cec1dca3.en: “Snipe all territories? That’s—different—I think.” Harry adjusted his pants, feeling his privates glued to his inner thigh, nearly falling backward as he performed such simple task. “Can—can you explain?” Harry released a wet burp that sounded dangerously close to being upgraded into a puke.
ac18cec1dca3.t: “Tembak semua wilayah? Itu—lain—rasanya.” Harry membetulkan seluarnya, merasakan kemaluannya melekat pada peha dalamnya, hampir terjatuh ke belakang ketika melakukan tugas semudah itu. “Bo—boleh awak terangkan?” Harry melepaskan sendawa basah yang kedengaran amat hampir dinaik taraf menjadi muntah.

aca7e02d4ce2.en: Carefully pouring the rest of the black honey into Harry’s mouth, the maid went to the bathroom to clean away the vial. A familiar gush of angry water sounded from the bathroom when she pulled the handle above the sink.
aca7e02d4ce2.t: Dengan berhati-hati menuang baki madu hitam ke dalam mulut Harry, pembantu rumah itu pergi ke bilik mandi untuk membersihkan botol kecil itu. Bunyi curahan air marah yang biasa kedengaran dari bilik mandi apabila dia menarik pemegang di atas sinki.

ad2fc975681b.en: Vol 2 Chapter I subchapter 1: a woman in a red hat and black dress sits knitting beside Harry, who lies shirtless in bed.
ad2fc975681b.t: Jilid 2 Bab I subbab 1: seorang wanita bertopi merah dan bergaun hitam duduk mengait di sebelah Harry, yang terbaring tanpa baju di atas katil.

ada417191285.en: Eiri played with her quill as she stared back at blank Harry. “You know, that’s pretty ballsy coming to the king-maid’s office and then flat out ignoring me.” Eiri kept on looking as Harry’s expression seemed stuck in time. “You okay, Harry?”
ada417191285.t: Eiri bermain dengan bulu penanya sambil merenung kembali Harry yang kosong. “Kau tahu, berani betul datang ke pejabat king-maid lepas tu tak endahkan aku langsung.” Eiri terus memandang sementara riak Harry seakan-akan tersekat dalam masa. “Kau okey, Harry?”

b205be12f256.en: “SO YOU’RE GOING TO LEAVE JUST LIKE THAT?” Kaiana angrily shouted at Takeo, who was walking out of the bar with determination in his step and not even a glint of wanting to look back.
b205be12f256.t: “JADI KAU NAK PERGI MACAM TU JE?” Kaiana menjerit dengan marah kepada Takeo, yang berjalan keluar dari bar dengan tekad dalam langkahnya dan tiada sedikit pun keinginan untuk menoleh.

b302b02524ca.en: “You’re welcome!” Aurora remained standing up, now looking at the clothes laid out by Harry. “Honey, do you need any help with that? You don’t need to bathe; I did that last night.”
b302b02524ca.t: “Sama-sama!” Aurora terus berdiri, kini memandang pakaian yang dibentangkan di sebelah Harry. “Nak, perlukan bantuan dengan tu? Kau tak perlu mandi; makcik dah mandikan kau semalam.”

b3adb798f011.en: “Hold a hunk, brotha!” Hiromi opened the leather bag, pulled out a single amethyst crusted in golden metal, and handed it to Harry.
b3adb798f011.t: “Tunggu kejap, brader!” Hiromi membuka beg kulit itu, mengeluarkan sebiji amethyst bersalut logam emas, dan menghulurkannya kepada Harry.

b3c0542c9303.en: Hiromi threw a four-punch streak with all his might, but Yacamim kept evading and blocking everything. “I’m too drunk for this!” He defended two sloppy punches, and then a solid kick from Yacamim that took away his breath. “Fu—” He couldn’t even curse as he felt his chest muscles tearing under the skin. Redoing the same punch streak again, but on the last punch, he faked it out, then threw a forward kick with all his might, probably to show her off his own lower body strength.
b3c0542c9303.t: Hiromi melontarkan siri empat tumbukan dengan sepenuh tenaga, tetapi Yacamim terus mengelak dan menahan semuanya. “Aku terlalu mabuk untuk ni!” Dia menahan dua tumbukan yang selekeh, dan kemudian tendangan padu dari Yacamim yang membuatkannya hilang nafas. “Ce—” Dia tidak sempat pun menyumpah ketika dia merasakan otot dadanya koyak di bawah kulit. Mengulangi siri tumbukan yang sama sekali lagi, tetapi pada tumbukan terakhir, dia mengacah, kemudian melontarkan tendangan ke depan dengan sepenuh tenaga, mungkin untuk menunjukkan kekuatan bahagian bawah tubuhnya sendiri.

b46044efcbe4.en: “We’re in this together, but you gotta tell me!” Eiri let go of Harry’s shoulder and rested her weight against the table, crossing her arm as her perked-up ears looked to be hanging at every word of his babbling.
b46044efcbe4.t: “Kita lalui ni bersama, tapi kau kena bagi tahu aku!” Eiri melepaskan bahu Harry dan menyandarkan berat badannya pada meja, memeluk tubuh sementara telinganya yang tegak kelihatan bergantung pada setiap patah kata celotehnya.

b5ca149a3c2c.en: In the back of his mind, a thought rushed by. Perhaps this whole thing was nothing but a vivid bullshit nightmare fueled by several sleepless nights of working in a meaningless cubicle job that he compensated with binge eating like a hog. He must still be plopping his big fat ass on the same old fart-soaked recliner with beer on one side and tacos on the other. C’mon! Just wake me up already! I wanna go home!
b5ca149a3c2c.t: Di belakang fikirannya, satu fikiran menerpa. Mungkin semua ini tidak lain hanyalah mimpi ngeri karut yang jelas yang dibakar oleh beberapa malam tanpa tidur bekerja di kubikel yang tidak bermakna yang dibalasnya dengan makan berlebihan seperti babi. Dia mesti masih menghenyakkan punggung gemuknya di kerusi malas lama yang sama yang berbau kentut dengan bir di satu sisi dan taco di sisi lain. Ayuh! Bangunkan aku je! Aku nak balik rumah!

b8172e764bf0.en: Bursting out laughing, Hiromi almost choked on his drink as well, seeing Harry looking like he had just drunk gasoline. “I think I did it a bit too strong—oh well, you will get used to it. By the way, have you been told the story of how I met her?” He pointed towards the door to the atrium, where Yacamim was long gone.
b8172e764bf0.t: Meledak ketawa, Hiromi hampir tercekik minumannya juga, melihat Harry kelihatan seperti baru minum petrol. “Rasanya aku buat kuat sangat—tak apalah, nanti kau biasa. By the way, kau dah pernah dengar cerita macam mana aku jumpa dia?” Dia menunjuk ke arah pintu ke atrium, di mana Yacamim sudah lama pergi.

b861bb368fba.en: “Hehehe. Go figure.” The Darfaries adventurer raised his deep voice towards the open door where Yacamim had just walked through. “Hey yo! Monnahigh at Shaved Bagarisa?”
b861bb368fba.t: “Hehehe. Dah agak.” Pengembara Darfaries itu meninggikan suaranya yang dalam ke arah pintu terbuka yang baru dilalui Yacamim. “Hei yo! Monnahigh kat Shaved Bagarisa?”

bd69e93c0563.en: Harry felt a familiar sweet honey smell from the black goo hit the back of his nose with such intensity that it was repugnant. His empty stomach curled up, forcing him to dry-heave like some cats do when smelling cheese or sour cream.
bd69e93c0563.t: Harry merasakan bau madu manis yang biasa dari lendir hitam itu menghentam belakang hidungnya dengan begitu kuat sehingga menjijikkan. Perutnya yang kosong meringkuk, memaksanya termuntah kering seperti sesetengah kucing apabila menghidu keju atau krim masam.

bda1ede24b5c.en: “Spare the deets. I got the gist from Itagiba.” This brute pointed towards the door. “Her sister went overboard like usual.”
bda1ede24b5c.t: “Tak payah cerita butiran. Aku dah faham intipatinya dari Itagiba.” Lelaki garang ini menunjuk ke arah pintu. “Kakak dia melampau macam biasa.”

c00e22633639.en: “No—wait. I actually need to go talk with Eiri first!” Harry pointed towards the still half-open door Yacamim had left through to the atrium, remembering the royal offices were upstairs.
c00e22633639.t: “Tak—kejap. Sebenarnya saya perlu pergi bercakap dengan Eiri dulu!” Harry menunjuk ke arah pintu yang masih separuh terbuka yang dilalui Yacamim ke atrium, teringat pejabat-pejabat diraja berada di tingkat atas.

c07428bd4398.en: With a rumble, Harry’s stomach groaned over his full bladder, still pressuring him. Picking up the cookie from the thatch box, he looked at the maid’s caramel eyes. “Thank you—ahh—” His mind drew blank, not because he forgot her name, but surely never heard it in the first place.
c07428bd4398.t: Dengan bunyi berkeroncong, perut Harry merungut mengatasi pundi kencingnya yang penuh, yang masih menekannya. Mengambil biskut itu dari kotak jerami, dia memandang mata karamel pembantu rumah itu. “Terima kasih—ahh—” Fikirannya kosong, bukan kerana dia lupa namanya, tetapi pastinya dia tidak pernah mendengarnya pada mulanya.

c091da4331d9.en: Eiri sighed as the shine in her eyes faded. “It couldn’t have happened within the castle grounds. There are always guards at the main entrance, and my maids are handpicked and vigilant—for all we know, the memory seems so vague that it could have been a guy. I’m sorry, Harry, I am! But all I can say at this point is to have you keep trying to dig through your memories. They must have injected some nasty stuff to scramble your brain, but if you get me any specific details, then I can help you by opening a missing person search quest! That way, we can gather hints of someone who crossed paths with you without accusing anyone!” Eiri gave Harry a motherly hug. “Not that I don’t want to bring justice to whoever did this to you, but we can only accuse someone if we have proof. Or we’re the ones who will be punished.”
c091da4331d9.t: Eiri mengeluh sementara sinar di matanya pudar. “Tak mungkin ia berlaku dalam kawasan istana. Sentiasa ada pengawal kat pintu masuk utama, dan pembantu-pembantu rumah aku dipilih sendiri dan berwaspada—setakat yang kita tahu, ingatan tu nampak begitu samar sampai mungkin juga lelaki. Maaf, Harry, betul! Tapi apa yang aku boleh cakap setakat ni ialah suruh kau terus cuba menggali ingatan kau. Mereka mesti dah suntik benda jahat untuk kacau otak kau, tapi kalau kau bagi aku apa-apa butiran khusus, aku boleh tolong kau dengan buka misi pencarian orang hilang! Dengan cara tu, kita boleh kumpul petunjuk tentang seseorang yang pernah bertemu kau tanpa menuduh sesiapa!” Eiri memberikan Harry pelukan keibuan. “Bukannya aku tak nak bawa keadilan kepada sesiapa yang buat ni kat kau, tapi kita cuma boleh tuduh seseorang kalau kita ada bukti. Kalau tak kita yang akan dihukum.”

c0c97fa51a6a.en: “Days? But—but I fought Maiara this morning!” Harry placed his feet on the cold wooden floor and peeked towards the open window, seeing a sunny day shine down in the lively city. “Ahh—right?”
c0c97fa51a6a.t: “Hari? Tapi—tapi saya lawan Maiara pagi tadi!” Harry meletakkan kakinya di lantai kayu yang sejuk dan mengintai ke arah tingkap yang terbuka, melihat hari yang cerah menyinari kota yang meriah. “Ahh—kan?”

c2a491facc72.en: “Ahhh—hi!” Harry froze up, seeing this ridiculously buffed man, even more so than Itagiba, standing in a weird pose, asking Harry to come at him. “Ehh—I’m sorry, but—I need to go see Eiri.”
c2a491facc72.t: “Ahhh—hai!” Harry membeku, melihat lelaki yang sangat sasa ini, lebih sasa daripada Itagiba, berdiri dalam pose yang pelik, meminta Harry datang kepadanya. “Ehh—maaf, tapi—saya perlu pergi jumpa Eiri.”

c2e17afac07c.en: “No! I got this!” Hiromi placed one hand at the table’s end, swiping the booze-soaked sliced lolish off the table and into his hand. He squeezed the excess back into the table and plopped the sliced lolish into both drinks. With a triumphant smile, he wiped his hands on his armor. “Aiight! Let’s go!”
c2e17afac07c.t: “Tak! Aku boleh!” Hiromi meletakkan sebelah tangan di hujung meja, menyapu hirisan lolish yang basah dengan arak dari meja ke dalam tangannya. Dia memerah lebihannya kembali ke meja dan memasukkan hirisan lolish itu ke dalam kedua-dua minuman. Dengan senyuman kemenangan, dia mengesat tangannya pada baju zirahnya. “Okeylah! Jom!”

c4024e0fec07.en: Trying to get caught up, Harry began throwing darts too, but it looked like he sprayed dartboard repellant on them as most were clicking off the board or the nearby walls. With each dart throw, Harry was slowing down. His face was growing paler, strained. One of his last darts clung tightly against a sizeable orange section in the board, giving him a rushing feeling, or the rushing sensation was from his stomach rumbling as it began its final preparations before pressing the nuclear button. Throwing the last dart as he breathed heavily, the room started to move too much. He clashed against Hiromi as he lost his balance.
c4024e0fec07.t: Cuba mengejar, Harry turut mula membaling dart, tetapi ia kelihatan seperti dia menyembur penghalau papan dart padanya kerana kebanyakannya berdetak jatuh dari papan atau dinding berdekatan. Dengan setiap balingan dart, Harry semakin perlahan. Wajahnya semakin pucat, tegang. Salah satu dart terakhirnya melekat erat pada bahagian oren yang agak besar di papan, memberinya perasaan teruja, atau sensasi teruja itu dari perutnya yang berkeroncong ketika ia memulakan persiapan terakhir sebelum menekan butang nuklear. Membaling dart terakhir sambil bernafas berat, bilik itu mula bergerak terlalu banyak. Dia merempuh Hiromi kerana hilang keseimbangan.

c51dbcafb0f9.en: The grandmotherly maid glanced over quietly, still crocheting away.
c51dbcafb0f9.t: Pembantu rumah seperti nenek itu mengerling dalam diam, masih mengait.

c6802e6f9f65.en: The excessive crunchiness of the finger cake was scraping the roof of Harry’s mouth. That was at least until his teeth dug into its center, giving away a moist filling with red chunks inside. Like orange yet tarter, a sweet, tangy taste contrasted the crunchy outer outside. It was so good that Harry closed his eyes and clicked his tongue, chowing it down with a loud humming—like a kitten tasting meat for the first time. As he kept chewing it, the red chunks grabbed all the attention by releasing a crisp apple-like flavor into the mix. Within three bites, the cake became one with Harry. “Hmmm—this is really tasty! Thank you, Aurora!”
c6802e6f9f65.t: Kerangupan kek jari yang berlebihan itu menggaru lelangit Harry. Sekurang-kurangnya sehingga giginya menembusi bahagian tengahnya, mendedahkan inti yang lembap dengan ketulan merah di dalamnya. Seperti oren tetapi lebih masam, rasa manis dan masam kontras dengan bahagian luar yang rangup. Ia begitu sedap sehingga Harry memejamkan matanya dan mendecit lidahnya, melahapnya dengan dengungan kuat—seperti anak kucing merasa daging buat pertama kali. Ketika dia terus mengunyahnya, ketulan merah itu menarik semua perhatian dengan melepaskan rasa seperti epal yang rangup ke dalam campuran itu. Dalam tiga gigitan, kek itu menjadi satu dengan Harry. “Hmmm—sedap betul ni! Terima kasih, Aurora!”

c7cb9b1e1c04.en: By himself now, Harry could only hear Aurora’s footsteps slowly clacking on the stairs while the familiar rustles of the city and gusts of humid salty wind rushed into the window. “Wait—these clothes are different.” The clothes Aurora laid on the bed beside him didn’t look as fancy as his previous clothes. They had a brownish base color, with Sanbi blue scales as accents. This looks like a company logo? On the right side of the shirt, there was also a Sanbi fish drawing sewn into the clothing. Oh shit! I really need to pee. Harry let go of the shirt and walked stiffly towards the bathroom. His bladder somehow made this issue even more urgent the closer he was to the oddly square toilet.
c7cb9b1e1c04.t: Kini bersendirian, Harry hanya dapat mendengar langkah Aurora perlahan-lahan berdetak di tangga sementara bunyi kota yang biasa dan tiupan angin masin yang lembap menerpa masuk ke tingkap. “Kejap—pakaian ni lain.” Pakaian yang Aurora bentangkan di atas katil di sebelahnya tidak kelihatan semewah pakaiannya sebelum ini. Ia berwarna asas keperangan, dengan sisik biru Sanbi sebagai hiasan. Ni macam logo syarikat? Di sebelah kanan baju, ada juga lukisan ikan Sanbi yang dijahit pada pakaian itu. Alamak! Aku betul-betul nak kencing. Harry melepaskan baju itu dan berjalan dengan kaku ke arah bilik mandi. Pundi kencingnya entah bagaimana menjadikan isu ini lebih mendesak semakin dia mendekati tandas segi empat yang pelik itu.

c99ed2961c48.en: As if this kind of event was not uncommon, people started to rustle around, forming an impromptu battleground by pushing tables away and creating a battlefield in the middle of the bar.
c99ed2961c48.t: Seolah-olah peristiwa seperti ini bukan sesuatu yang luar biasa, orang ramai mula bergerak ke sana ke mari, membentuk gelanggang spontan dengan menolak meja-meja ke tepi dan mewujudkan medan pertempuran di tengah-tengah bar.

caaf70bef125.en: Kaiana and Hiromi smiled at each other as they finished the ritualistic Darfaries hug, then Kaiana jumped out of the chair and waved goodbye as she walked out of the door.
caaf70bef125.t: Kaiana dan Hiromi tersenyum antara satu sama lain ketika mereka selesai pelukan ritual Darfaries itu, kemudian Kaiana melompat dari kerusi dan melambai selamat tinggal sambil berjalan keluar dari pintu.

cacc1e317bfe.en: “But—Sora. I have—to go! I need—to tell—Eiri!” The words barely came out in between his breaths. His dilated pupils looked at the maid with all the remaining will he could muster, as the vision of being suffocated by a girly figure was prominent in his mind.
cacc1e317bfe.t: “Tapi—Sora. Saya kena—pergi! Saya perlu—bagi tahu—Eiri!” Kata-kata itu hampir tidak keluar di antara nafasnya. Anak matanya yang membesar memandang pembantu rumah itu dengan sisa kemahuan yang mampu dikumpulnya, sementara bayangan dilemaskan oleh susuk tubuh perempuan menonjol dalam fikirannya.

cb1746e35bf4.en: Hiromi let out a long hum as his eyes seemed to long for her already. “After we used Body Restore on each other, we went back to her room.” Hiromi let out a smirk, seemingly just talking aloud to himself. “I still remember pulling that awesome blackish-purple hair like it was yesterday. I just couldn’t stop cumming—”
cb1746e35bf4.t: Hiromi berdengung panjang sementara matanya seakan-akan sudah merinduinya. “Lepas kami guna Body Restore pada satu sama lain, kami balik ke bilik dia.” Hiromi tersenyum sinis, nampaknya sekadar bercakap kuat sendirian. “Aku masih ingat tarik rambut ungu kehitaman yang mantap tu macam baru semalam. Aku tak boleh berhenti terpancut—”

cc45b578ef1e.en: “I—this dream I had—I thought it was a dream, but now I remember more—I think—” Harry glanced at Eiri, his voice growing weaker.
cc45b578ef1e.t: “Saya—mimpi yang saya alami ni—saya ingat itu mimpi, tapi sekarang saya ingat lebih banyak—rasanya—” Harry mengerling Eiri, suaranya semakin lemah.

cd3e122359df.en: “You fought Maiara on the morning of Paulin fifteenth. Today is the seventeenth, close to Sunnohigh right now.” The maid returned from the bathroom and hid away the vial deep in her crochet kit with a victorious smile on her face—if one were to guess, it’s not every day a lovely old grandmother goes against the rules. “I’m really sorry, honey, but when you lose that much weight that quickly, you will feel funny for a bit. King-maid told me that the queen’s order was because of the Sanbi-eye job.”
cd3e122359df.t: “Kau lawan Maiara pada pagi lima belas Paulin. Hari ni tujuh belas haribulan, dah hampir Sunnohigh sekarang.” Pembantu rumah itu kembali dari bilik mandi dan menyembunyikan botol kecil itu jauh di dalam set mengaitnya dengan senyuman kemenangan di wajahnya—jika diteka, bukan setiap hari seorang nenek tua yang baik hati melanggar peraturan. “Makcik betul-betul minta maaf, nak, tapi bila kau turun berat sebanyak tu dengan cepat, kau akan rasa pelik sekejap. King-maid bagi tahu makcik perintah permaisuri tu sebab kerja Sanbi-eye.”

cec387f7cdcf.en: Meanwhile, the bar was completely lit up! The verbal bets and cheering in the background filled the room with noise and excitement. “Go, Yacamim! Go Yacamim! Represent Sanbi!” The room blew up even more when she began to stand up, regaining her foothold and tightening her fists in her version strength display.
cec387f7cdcf.t: Sementara itu, bar itu benar-benar meriah! Taruhan lisan dan sorakan di latar belakang memenuhi bilik dengan bunyi dan keterujaan. “Ayuh, Yacamim! Ayuh Yacamim! Wakili Sanbi!” Bilik itu lebih meletup apabila dia mula berdiri, kembali berdiri teguh dan mengepal penumbuknya dalam versi pameran kekuatannya.

d3b29586c738.en: “You’re welcome, hon! In that case, I’m going to go ahead and let King-maid Eiri know you’re awake. Take your time.” The maid gave another big smile as she picked up her crochet bag and left the room, closing the door carefully to avoid making too much noise.
d3b29586c738.t: “Sama-sama, nak! Kalau macam tu, makcik pergi dulu bagi tahu King-maid Eiri yang kau dah bangun. Ambil masa kau.” Pembantu rumah itu memberikan satu lagi senyuman lebar sambil mengambil beg mengaitnya dan meninggalkan bilik, menutup pintu dengan berhati-hati untuk mengelak membuat terlalu banyak bunyi.

d3ceaa518ec1.en: Clearing his throat, Hiromi seemed to have caught up to what he had just said. His big hands swiped the excess drink off his chitin armor as he laughed it off. “They might look alike, but they are pretty different after all. If it was Maiara, I bet that would have never happened—there you go. That was the grand tale, but hey, at least you can still suck on the kingdom’s tits with an easy job!” Hiromi brought his nearly-empty jar closer to Harry with a bright smile that even made his large tusks shine.
d3ceaa518ec1.t: Berdehem, Hiromi seakan-akan tersedar apa yang baru dikatakannya. Tangannya yang besar menyapu lebihan minuman dari baju zirah kitinnya sambil dia ketawa melepaskannya. “Mereka mungkin nampak serupa, tapi mereka agak berbeza sebenarnya. Kalau Maiara, aku pasti benda tu takkan pernah berlaku—hah, macam tu la. Itulah kisah agungnya, tapi hei, sekurang-kurangnya kau masih boleh hisap tetek kerajaan dengan kerja senang!” Hiromi mendekatkan balangnya yang hampir kosong kepada Harry dengan senyuman ceria yang malah membuatkan taringnya yang besar bersinar.

d46172e291ef.en: “I’ve been working on this one for a while. Glad it worked!” Eiri smiled cheerfully. “Now, are you ready? How’s your stomach feeling? Do you need anything to eat?” Eiri checked Harry’s new uniform out. “Actually, since you shared your secret, I will share mine too. You look better with less weight, but I still don’t agree with the monarchy’s department, or rather Neferteri’s decision.”
d46172e291ef.t: “Aku dah lama berlatih yang tu. Seronok ia berkesan!” Eiri tersenyum ceria. “Sekarang, dah sedia? Macam mana perut kau? Perlukan apa-apa untuk makan?” Eiri meneliti pakaian seragam baharu Harry. “Sebenarnya, alang-alang kau dah kongsi rahsia kau, aku kongsi rahsia aku juga. Kau nampak lebih bagus dengan berat yang kurang, tapi aku masih tak setuju dengan jabatan monarki, atau lebih tepat keputusan Neferteri.”

d4b6cd204a56.en: “Yo! So, I guess you’re the Harry guy?” A stronger-willed gruff voice of intense bass came out of the scary-looking large humanoid sitting at the bar by Yacamim. It was a Darfaries, a humanoid species known for its large size with girthy tusks, floppy ears, and a nerve resembling a varicose vein that pops up from the tip of the middle and ring fingers and travels through the back and down the other hand.
d4b6cd204a56.t: “Yo! Jadi, rasanya kau mamat Harry tu?” Suara garau yang lebih berkemahuan kuat dengan bes yang mendalam keluar dari makhluk berupa manusia yang besar dan kelihatan menakutkan yang duduk di bar di sebelah Yacamim. Ia seorang Darfaries, spesies berupa manusia yang terkenal dengan saiznya yang besar dengan taring tebal, telinga terkulai, dan saraf menyerupai urat varikos yang timbul dari hujung jari tengah dan jari manis dan menjalar melalui belakang dan turun ke tangan yang lagi satu.

d57880db8482.en: Another gagging sound came out of Harry as he held his mouth. Whatever he clashed into gave a nick on his forehead, and he started bleeding.
d57880db8482.t: Satu lagi bunyi nak muntah keluar dari Harry sambil dia menekup mulutnya. Apa sahaja yang dirempuhnya meninggalkan luka kecil di dahinya, dan dia mula berdarah.

d6dce634a3c4.en: “HIROMI HIGH-GANDEW TOUGH-HAMMER!” Hiromi said in a powerful, deep voice, echoing in the bar loudly enough to be far above the chatter. The Darfaries folks amongst the crowd, who were few and far between compared to other races, seemed to almost in unison raise their mug towards them—like a sort of acknowledgment. Meanwhile, most of the others present didn’t seem to give two shits.
d6dce634a3c4.t: “HIROMI HIGH-GANDEW TOUGH-HAMMER!” Hiromi berkata dengan suara yang kuat dan dalam, bergema di bar cukup kuat untuk jauh mengatasi celoteh. Orang-orang Darfaries di kalangan orang ramai, yang sedikit dan jarang berbanding bangsa lain, seakan-akan hampir serentak mengangkat kole mereka ke arah mereka—seperti sejenis pengiktirafan. Sementara itu, kebanyakan yang lain yang hadir langsung tidak peduli.

d7fece0fb0eb.en: Harry touched his stomach; it felt a bit tender and very empty. “It felt really weird at first, but I think I’m getting used to it. Actually, I’m not sure if I am that hungry at the moment. I think I drank too much.”
d7fece0fb0eb.t: Harry menyentuh perutnya; ia terasa sedikit lembut sakitnya dan sangat kosong. “Rasa betul-betul pelik pada mulanya, tapi rasanya saya dah mula biasa. Sebenarnya, saya tak pasti saya lapar sangat buat masa ni. Rasanya saya terlebih minum.”

d9189d45d246.en: Apparently, the massive Darfaries man quickly didn’t seem to take kindly to being left hanging; at least one could tell by his souring face as he kept on holding the pose. Somehow, his large tusks now looked quite pointy and threatening. “No shit! You really don’t know about the Darfaires handshake?” Pure disbelief coursed through his voice as his large eyes stared Harry down—like a guy trying to pick a fight with you at a bar.
d9189d45d246.t: Nampaknya, lelaki Darfaries yang besar itu dengan cepat tidak suka dibiarkan tergantung; sekurang-kurangnya orang dapat lihat dari wajahnya yang semakin masam sambil dia terus mengekalkan pose itu. Entah bagaimana, taringnya yang besar kini kelihatan agak tajam dan mengancam. “Biar betul! Kau betul-betul tak tahu pasal salam Darfaires?” Rasa tidak percaya tulen mengalir dalam suaranya ketika matanya yang besar merenung Harry—seperti lelaki yang cuba mencari gaduh dengan kau di bar.

da1d4328e062.en: Harry was mesmerized by the familiar blurry ceiling as the gush of water filled the background, louder than the noises from the city and birds chirping outside. A natural radiance of energy began to spread from his throat into his guts and outwardly into his body. Harry felt like someone had just transplanted his brain into a new body full of energy—the same energy you get when you wake up late in the morning without an alarm clock on the weekend and have a hearty breakfast with an excellent export-grade roast coffee. With a coughing fit, as he sat up in bed, Harry cleared his lung and felt the leftover sweet taste of the black honey taste mix with a salty, foul taste of the phlegm that was nearly choking him before.
da1d4328e062.t: Harry terpukau dengan siling kabur yang biasa itu sementara curahan air memenuhi latar belakang, lebih kuat daripada bunyi kota dan kicauan burung di luar. Pancaran tenaga semula jadi mula merebak dari kerongkongnya ke dalam perutnya dan ke luar ke seluruh tubuhnya. Harry merasakan seolah-olah seseorang baru memindahkan otaknya ke dalam tubuh baharu yang penuh tenaga—tenaga yang sama yang kau dapat bila bangun lewat pagi tanpa jam loceng pada hujung minggu dan bersarapan dengan kopi bancuhan gred eksport yang hebat. Dengan batuk yang bertubi-tubi, ketika dia duduk di atas katil, Harry melegakan paru-parunya dan merasakan sisa rasa manis madu hitam bercampur dengan rasa masin dan busuk kahak yang hampir mencekiknya tadi.

daf08b8cd71d.en: Kaiana pulled a chair, then stood on it—perhaps she was aware enough of their height differences that, without a chair, her head would be awfully close to Hiromi’s junk when they touched bodies. Matching Hiromi’s pose, she got face-to-face with him. “KAIANA DELTACROSS!” She shouted in the bar, catching everyone’s attention as her breasts got squished against Hiromi’s armor.
daf08b8cd71d.t: Kaiana menarik sebuah kerusi, kemudian berdiri di atasnya—mungkin dia cukup sedar tentang perbezaan ketinggian mereka sehingga, tanpa kerusi, kepalanya akan sangat dekat dengan kemaluan Hiromi apabila tubuh mereka bersentuhan. Menyamai pose Hiromi, dia bersemuka dengannya. “KAIANA DELTACROSS!” Dia menjerit di bar, menarik perhatian semua orang ketika buah dadanya terhimpit pada baju zirah Hiromi.

db3053cb424f.en: Looking down like a puppy caught chewing on sandals, Harry showed the amethyst ball again to Eiri. “Hiromi told—told that I should just—enjoy life a bit. I had a bit much and—almost puked in the parlor. He brought me to the bathroom, but he broke the door.” Harry gave the amethyst ball to Eiri. “He gave me this to pay for it—I’m sorry.”
db3053cb424f.t: Menunduk seperti anak anjing yang tertangkap menggigit selipar, Harry menunjukkan bola amethyst itu sekali lagi kepada Eiri. “Hiromi kata—kata saya patut—nikmati hidup sikit. Saya terlebih sikit dan—hampir muntah kat ruang tamu. Dia bawa saya ke bilik air, tapi dia pecahkan pintu.” Harry memberikan bola amethyst itu kepada Eiri. “Dia bagi saya ni untuk bayar—maaf.”

dc7b3e8a08f6.en: Harry kept looking, assuming Hiromi would abuse the slicer like he did the muddler, maybe even break it in half. However, he didn’t seem to apply all his pent-up anger to it. Instead, he moved the root on the slicer with good enough precision to avoid slicing his giant hands in the process, making several slices of lolish root, some thin, some not so thin. The slices were being plumped on the table. When he was done, he waved the slicer in the air to dry it, letting juices drip all over, before shoving it back on the cabinet below—perhaps the real reason this mandoline slicer was fucked up wasn’t age after all, but abuse by certain functioning alcoholics.
dc7b3e8a08f6.t: Harry terus memerhati, menyangka Hiromi akan menyalahgunakan penghiris itu seperti yang dilakukannya kepada penumbuk, malah mungkin mematahkannya separuh. Namun, dia tidak kelihatan mencurahkan semua kemarahan terpendamnya padanya. Sebaliknya, dia menggerakkan akar itu pada penghiris dengan ketepatan yang cukup baik untuk mengelak menghiris tangan gergasinya dalam proses itu, membuat beberapa hirisan akar lolish, sesetengahnya nipis, sesetengahnya tidak berapa nipis. Hirisan-hirisan itu jatuh ke atas meja. Apabila dia selesai, dia melambai-lambaikan penghiris itu di udara untuk mengeringkannya, membiarkan jus menitis merata-rata, sebelum menyumbatnya semula ke kabinet di bawah—mungkin sebab sebenar penghiris mandolin ini rosak bukanlah usia, tetapi penyalahgunaan oleh peminum alkohol tertentu yang masih berfungsi.

de1bb3113476.en: “I’m sorry, honey. I know it’s strong, but you will feel much better.” Her eyes shone with the worry of a grandmother who is told she can’t feed her grandkids whatever she wants to. “King-maid told me I couldn’t bring you back to how you looked before because it was an order from the queen. I’m truly sorry, hon—I can only give you this much black honey.”
de1bb3113476.t: “Maaf, nak. Makcik tahu ia kuat, tapi kau akan rasa lebih baik.” Matanya bersinar dengan kerisauan seorang nenek yang diberitahu dia tidak boleh memberi cucunya makan apa sahaja yang dia mahu. “King-maid kata makcik tak boleh kembalikan kau macam rupa kau dulu sebab itu perintah permaisuri. Makcik betul-betul minta maaf, nak—makcik cuma boleh bagi madu hitam sebanyak ni.”

de280bcdc64d.en: The bar chatter quickly died down, as if everyone’s mother was insulted simultaneously. A tense atmosphere took over the place as if a grand jury were about to state their verdict to the defendant.
de280bcdc64d.t: Celoteh bar cepat-cepat senyap, seolah-olah ibu semua orang dihina serentak. Suasana tegang mengambil alih tempat itu seolah-olah juri besar hendak mengumumkan keputusan mereka kepada defendan.

e112670ad7c2.en: Harry slowly opened his eyes to the blinding light of a sunny day. His head, then his upper body, felt a gust of humid breeze pass by. His nose picked up a familiar salty with a slightly fishy smell filling up the room; it kinda smelled like home. His body felt tender, somewhat warm too. Not only from the sun tickling his skin but from within as well—like that funky feeling somewhere between dull pain and fever you get when going to bed after spending all day playing on a sunny beach, getting wasted on cheap beer while gorging on seafood.
e112670ad7c2.t: Harry perlahan-lahan membuka matanya kepada cahaya menyilaukan hari yang cerah. Kepalanya, kemudian bahagian atas tubuhnya, merasakan tiupan bayu lembap berlalu. Hidungnya menangkap bau masin yang biasa dengan sedikit bau hanyir memenuhi bilik; ia agak berbau seperti rumah. Tubuhnya terasa lembut sakitnya, agak hangat juga. Bukan sahaja dari matahari yang menggeletek kulitnya tetapi dari dalam juga—seperti perasaan pelik di antara sakit tumpul dan demam yang kau dapat bila tidur selepas seharian bermain di pantai yang cerah, mabuk dengan bir murah sambil melahap makanan laut.

e20fc2706992.en: Vol 2 Chapter I subchapter 4: Harry drinks from a big mug while the laughing mohawked giant and a dark-haired woman look on.
e20fc2706992.t: Jilid 2 Bab I subbab 4: Harry minum dari kole besar sementara gergasi berjambul mohawk yang ketawa dan seorang wanita berambut gelap memerhati.

e398556a0eda.en: “Aiight!” Hiromi threw a dart at the board, but it clung and fell to the ground. “Just a hunk—that was me warming up!” He threw another, and it landed miraculously on a green section close to the center. “Now try to throw on a green section or anywhere else.”
e398556a0eda.t: “Okeylah!” Hiromi membaling sebatang dart ke papan, tetapi ia melekat sekejap dan jatuh ke lantai. “Kejap je—tadi tu aku memanaskan badan!” Dia membaling satu lagi, dan ia mendarat dengan ajaib di bahagian hijau berhampiran tengah. “Sekarang cuba baling kat bahagian hijau atau mana-mana tempat lain.”

e40500ca3fc3.en: Helping Harry towards the sink, Hiromi glanced back at Arukia with narrow eyes and a sulking face that made his tusks look even more threatening. “I made the job easier for you, or did you want to clean puke off the floor?” His pointed voice sounded like an actual ultimatum this time.
e40500ca3fc3.t: Membantu Harry ke sinki, Hiromi mengerling semula ke arah Arukia dengan mata mengecil dan wajah merajuk yang membuatkan taringnya kelihatan lebih mengancam. “Aku dah mudahkan kerja kau, atau kau nak bersihkan muntah kat lantai?” Suaranya yang tajam kedengaran seperti kata dua sebenar kali ini.

e41c6263b1db.en: Like a rabbit fleeing a wolf, Sora jumped out of her chair and exited the room so quickly that it felt like she had superhuman or, more specifically, super-wozefaries capabilities.
e41c6263b1db.t: Seperti arnab melarikan diri dari serigala, Sora melompat dari kerusinya dan keluar dari bilik begitu cepat sehingga terasa seperti dia mempunyai kebolehan luar biasa manusia atau, lebih khusus, luar biasa wozefaries.

e55bb1765c1f.en: Harry’s ears rang. With spit on his face and a burst of weirded-out estranged laughter, he felt the ritualistic energy taking hold. Remembering what his badge said when Kibe handed it over to him, he shouted back, trying to match the same firmness as the behemoth of muscly humanoid, “Harry Sanbi!” It wasn’t a bad attempt, but not even close to Hiromi’s.
e55bb1765c1f.t: Telinga Harry berdesing. Dengan air liur di mukanya dan ledakan ketawa janggal yang kehairanan, dia merasakan tenaga ritual itu mengambil alih. Teringat apa yang tertulis pada lencananya ketika Kibe menyerahkannya kepadanya, dia menjerit balas, cuba menyamai ketegasan yang sama seperti gergasi berotot berupa manusia itu, “Harry Sanbi!” Ia bukan percubaan yang teruk, tetapi langsung tidak hampir dengan Hiromi.

e60431b3e747.en: “Eww—” With curled lips, Arukia looked away from Harry, who looked half-dead, and focused on Hiromi’s reddened cheeks. “Did you just kick down the door? Why? What is wrong with you? You could just have turned the knob!”
e60431b3e747.t: “Eee—” Dengan bibir mencebik, Arukia mengalihkan pandangan dari Harry, yang kelihatan separuh mati, dan menumpukan perhatian pada pipi Hiromi yang memerah. “Kau baru tendang pintu tu ke? Kenapa? Apa yang tak kena dengan kau? Kau boleh je pulas tombol!”

e61db5d0dc04.en: You okay, Harry? Eiri’s voice reverberated deep in Harry’s brain, snapping him out of his drunken daze. “I’m sorry, Eiri—it’s just—” Harry took a deep breath to fight the tightening feeling in his chest. “It’s just—” The words were not coming out. It can’t be her, can it? This feeling that he had drunk a pot of coffee was still there. Looking towards Sora, still just as busy as before, the words in his brain seemed jumbled, impossible to just flat out say in front of her.
e61db5d0dc04.t: Kau okey, Harry? Suara Eiri bergema jauh di dalam otak Harry, menyentapnya keluar dari khayal mabuknya. “Maaf, Eiri—cuma—” Harry menarik nafas dalam untuk melawan perasaan sesak di dadanya. “Cuma—” Kata-kata itu tidak keluar. Tak mungkin dia, kan? Perasaan seperti dia baru minum seteko kopi masih ada. Memandang ke arah Sora, yang masih sama sibuk seperti tadi, kata-kata dalam otaknya seakan-akan bercampur aduk, mustahil untuk dikatakan terus terang di hadapannya.

e6ba46501c70.en: “MY BAD! MY BAD! WE’RE ALMOST THERE!” Hiromi’s tensed-up voice sounded like he were trying to defuse a bomb before it exploded.
e6ba46501c70.t: “SALAH AKU! SALAH AKU! DAH NAK SAMPAI!” Suara Hiromi yang tegang kedengaran seperti dia cuba menjinakkan bom sebelum ia meletup.

e737173b9e06.en: Hiromi touched Harry’s back and pointed his half-drunken jar of lolish-floaters at Itanema, spilling some on the floor. “Just put it on my tab! It’s fine!”
e737173b9e06.t: Hiromi menyentuh belakang Harry dan menghalakan balang lolish-floaters yang separuh diminumnya ke arah Itanema, menumpahkan sedikit ke lantai. “Masukkan je dalam akaun aku! Tak apa!”

eade316ef031.en: “What?” Pulling his hand out from underneath the kilt, Hiromi had a leather bag about the size of his hand—luckily, it was his balls bag instead of his ballsack. “How many balls?”
eade316ef031.t: “Apa?” Menarik tangannya keluar dari bawah kilt, Hiromi memegang beg kulit kira-kira sebesar tangannya—nasib baik, itu beg bola duitnya dan bukannya beg telurnya. “Berapa bola?”

eaf21fc618f3.en: Looking at the detailed handiwork of the golden metal, Harry couldn’t stop noticing how pretty but foreign it looked. “So this is what people were talking about costing pearls or amethysts?”
eaf21fc618f3.t: Memandang hasil kerja tangan logam emas yang terperinci, Harry tidak dapat berhenti perasan betapa cantik tetapi asingnya ia. “Jadi inilah yang orang cakap harganya Pearl atau amethyst?”

eb8519c78219.en: A grin appeared on Eiri’s face; she winked towards Harry, then moved her head to Sora and spoke stridently, “What? Do you want to ask Sora to marry you? You need to take her to the Sanbi fountain first, then scream in front of everyone that you love her to soul death.”
eb8519c78219.t: Satu sengihan muncul di wajah Eiri; dia mengenyitkan mata kepada Harry, kemudian menggerakkan kepalanya ke arah Sora dan bercakap dengan lantang, “Apa? Kau nak lamar Sora ke? Kau kena bawa dia ke air pancut Sanbi dulu, lepas tu menjerit depan semua orang yang kau cintakan dia sampai mati jiwa.”

ec7666e50826.en: “Really?” Harry yelled out as the images of the duel with Maiara still lingered in his head, specifically when the people were helping him up and even chanting his name. So they didn’t care about me but instead just wanted the fight to continue? I guess that makes sense.
ec7666e50826.t: “Ye ke?” Harry menjerit sementara imej pertarungan dengan Maiara masih berlegar di kepalanya, khususnya ketika orang ramai membantunya bangun malah melaungkan namanya. Jadi mereka tak kisah pasal aku tapi cuma nak pertarungan tu diteruskan? Rasanya masuk akal.

ed912343e34d.en: Harry felt this ominous sensation of being mocked, but a more potent force within him made him utter, “She sat on my face—I—”
ed912343e34d.t: Harry merasakan sensasi tidak menyenangkan seperti diejek, tetapi kuasa yang lebih kuat dalam dirinya membuatnya berkata, “Dia duduk atas muka saya—saya—”

ef8ce0a84e0f.en: “But—but what about the ceiling?” Harry pointed up, then looked up as well. “Oh—” Harry’s crap eyes saw the same blurry white ceiling in Eiri’s office.
ef8ce0a84e0f.t: “Tapi—tapi macam mana dengan siling tu?” Harry menunjuk ke atas, kemudian turut mendongak. “Oh—” Mata Harry yang teruk nampak siling putih kabur yang sama di pejabat Eiri.

efaa909a9108.en: “Aiight.” Hiromi also stood up, approaching Kaiana with his hands up and belly facing forward. He then lowered his hand to match her height.
efaa909a9108.t: “Okeylah.” Hiromi turut berdiri, mendekati Kaiana dengan tangannya diangkat dan perutnya menghadap ke depan. Dia kemudian menurunkan tangannya untuk menyamai ketinggiannya.

f035e57d0202.en: Sora snapped her neck towards Eiri, then towards Harry, apparently only then realizing that he was right there. Her hands covered her quickly reddening face. Her eyes widened so much they were about to fall from their sockets as her body turned into stone—she even seemed to stop breathing because of how tensed up she was. The winga feather in her hand succumbed to the pressure and snapped loudly.
f035e57d0202.t: Sora menyentap lehernya ke arah Eiri, kemudian ke arah Harry, nampaknya baru menyedari bahawa dia ada di situ. Tangannya menekup wajahnya yang cepat memerah. Matanya terbeliak sehingga hampir terjatuh dari soketnya sementara tubuhnya menjadi batu—dia malah seakan-akan berhenti bernafas kerana betapa tegangnya dia. Bulu winga di tangannya mengalah kepada tekanan dan patah dengan kuat.

f076c096ddeb.en: “Hey, aren’t you gonna make a drink for us too?” The Darfaries seemed attentive to Yacamim’s muscular but still feminine body as she kept on walking away towards the exit to the atrium, where the stairs to the second floor, bathrooms, and kitchen door were.
f076c096ddeb.t: “Hei, kau tak nak buatkan minuman untuk kami juga ke?” Darfaries itu kelihatan memberi perhatian kepada tubuh Yacamim yang berotot tetapi masih kewanitaan ketika dia terus berjalan pergi ke arah pintu keluar ke atrium, di mana tangga ke tingkat dua, bilik air, dan pintu dapur berada.

f0b3a06e7f79.en: Vol 2 Chapter I subchapter 2: three men at a bar, one serving a green drink to a giant with a red-and-green mohawk.
f0b3a06e7f79.t: Jilid 2 Bab I subbab 2: tiga lelaki di bar, seorang menghidangkan minuman hijau kepada seorang gergasi berjambul mohawk merah dan hijau.

f20ad7325111.en: “I’m—sorry.” Feeling lightweight, Harry dry heaved a few more times, but only thick spit seemed to come out next. His teary eyes, snotty nose, and puke mixed with saliva dripping down his mouth were not a pleasant sight to behold, but his shivering died down, and with it, the feeling of spinning—perhaps that dark feeling inside him too.
f20ad7325111.t: “Sa—saya minta maaf.” Merasa ringan, Harry termuntah kering beberapa kali lagi, tetapi hanya air liur pekat yang nampaknya keluar seterusnya. Matanya yang berair, hidungnya yang berhingus, dan muntah bercampur air liur yang menitis dari mulutnya bukanlah pemandangan yang menyenangkan untuk dilihat, tetapi gigilannya reda, dan bersamanya, perasaan berpusing—mungkin perasaan gelap dalam dirinya juga.

f2320212bdd2.en: The “guy” with amazing blackish purple hair slapped Hiromi’s hand away, then took a big gulp of “his” beer.
f2320212bdd2.t: “Lelaki” dengan rambut ungu kehitaman yang hebat itu menepis tangan Hiromi, kemudian meneguk besar bir “nya”.

f3b01e80e9c7.en: “What? How?” Eiri’s voice sounded like a verbal two-combo word punch; however, her serious gaze didn’t seem aggressive but instigative for a solid answer.
f3b01e80e9c7.t: “Apa? Macam mana?” Suara Eiri kedengaran seperti tumbukan kombo dua patah kata; namun, renungannya yang serius tidak kelihatan agresif tetapi mendesak untuk jawapan yang kukuh.

f46004993ca1.en: Kaiana crossed her arms underneath her enormous boobs, making them even more salient. Her silent pouting seemed like a chord was struck. “Fine—he did give me his cut after all. Still, we could have made much more if he didn’t act alone, so it’s his own fault, dammit!”
f46004993ca1.t: Kaiana memeluk tubuh di bawah buah dadanya yang besar, menjadikannya lebih menonjol. Muncungnya yang senyap seakan-akan sesuatu telah terkena tepat. “Baiklah—dia memang bagi bahagian dia kat aku. Tetap juga, kita boleh dapat lebih banyak kalau dia tak bertindak seorang diri, jadi salah dia sendiri, sial!”

f489466282a2.en: Harry propped himself forward to ensure he wouldn’t fall backward by the sheer force and volume of the torrential pungent dark yellow stream coming out of his body that smelled worse than the bar’s back alley—maybe his urethra feeling like it was about rupture overstated the actual amount coming out, but in case like these, facts don’t matter, feelings do. Harry’s eyes drew attention to the bathtub where the dream, or rather, nightmare, or perhaps a past reality, surfaced. He could feel as if the same vicious-grinned girl was still sitting at the bathtub, waiting for him even though she clearly wasn’t there. His breathing became shallow, and his heart began to rise again as he was getting close to finishing peeing. As this chaotic feeling inside him took hold, a sense of urgency struck him. Or perhaps it was the incoming gag that came next. Taking a step back as a cold sweat rushed through his body, Harry propped himself on the nearby sink so tightly that his knuckles turned white. Tinnitus then struck him like a flashbang. With a pained groan, he held back the incoming gag with his dear life. I HATE THIS! His mind was growing tired of whatever the fuck was happening inside him.
f489466282a2.t: Harry menyandarkan dirinya ke depan untuk memastikan dia tidak terjatuh ke belakang kerana daya dan isi padu aliran kuning gelap yang deras dan hamis yang keluar dari tubuhnya yang berbau lebih teruk daripada lorong belakang bar—mungkin uretranya yang terasa seperti hendak pecah melebih-lebihkan jumlah sebenar yang keluar, tetapi dalam kes seperti ini, fakta tidak penting, perasaan yang penting. Mata Harry tertarik ke arah tab mandi di mana mimpi, atau lebih tepat, mimpi ngeri, atau mungkin realiti lalu, timbul. Dia dapat merasakan seolah-olah gadis yang sama dengan sengihan ganas itu masih duduk di tab mandi, menunggunya walaupun dia jelas tiada di situ. Nafasnya menjadi cetek, dan jantungnya mula berdegup kencang semula ketika dia hampir selesai kencing. Ketika perasaan huru-hara dalam dirinya ini mengambil alih, rasa mendesak menyerangnya. Atau mungkin rasa nak muntah yang datang seterusnya. Berundur selangkah ketika peluh sejuk menerpa ke seluruh tubuhnya, Harry berpaut pada sinki berdekatan begitu kuat sehingga buku limanya menjadi putih. Tinnitus kemudian menyerangnya seperti bom kilat. Dengan erangan kesakitan, dia menahan rasa nak muntah yang datang dengan sepenuh nyawanya. AKU BENCI NI! Fikirannya semakin penat dengan apa sahaja yang celaka sedang berlaku dalam dirinya.

f5ade27ba9a5.en: Without notice, a fist flew through the air from the “guy” and flattened Hiromi’s noise, sending his body backward, clashing against a table, making beer and food fly everywhere. With a bloody fist, this “guy” kept staring murderously at Hiromi. “I’m Yacamim, you meathead fuckwit. Remember the name next time you try to fuck with me!” Yacamim cleaned away her bloodied fist on her own bluish clothing and then pounded the rest of her beer as if nothing had happened.
f5ade27ba9a5.t: Tanpa amaran, satu penumbuk terbang di udara dari “lelaki” itu dan memenyekkan hidung Hiromi, menghantar tubuhnya ke belakang, merempuh sebuah meja, membuatkan bir dan makanan berterbangan ke merata tempat. Dengan penumbuk berdarah, “lelaki” ini terus merenung Hiromi dengan pandangan membunuh. “Aku Yacamim, kau bebal kepala otot celaka. Ingat nama ni lain kali kau cuba main-main dengan aku!” Yacamim mengesat penumbuknya yang berdarah pada pakaian kebiruannya sendiri dan kemudian meneguk habis baki birnya seolah-olah tiada apa-apa yang berlaku.

f628f8f4ad36.en: Black honey—yeah. The memory of Arukia’s tea came to mind. Opening his mouth, Harry began tasting this honey’s molasses-like taste characteristics, plus the crystallized sugar’s grainy texture as it rolled down his tongue. His stomach was on the fence at first, but then it made peace with it. This is not as bad as the stuff Arukia gave me.
f628f8f4ad36.t: Madu hitam—ha. Ingatan tentang teh Arukia terlintas di fikiran. Membuka mulutnya, Harry mula merasa ciri-ciri rasa madu ini yang seperti molases, ditambah tekstur berbutir gula yang menghablur ketika ia bergolek di lidahnya. Perutnya teragak-agak pada mulanya, tetapi kemudian ia berdamai dengannya. Ni tak seteruk benda yang Arukia bagi aku.

f6d411e6ed81.en: “Dang it. Aurora gave you Nari Refresher. Hmmm—I think there’s still a dose left from the one Eori made for you. Let’s go bug Kibe right now!” Eiri chuckled. “Unless you want it for dessert?”
f6d411e6ed81.t: “Alamak. Aurora bagi kau Nari Refresher. Hmmm—rasanya masih ada satu dos lagi dari yang Eori buat untuk kau. Jom kita kacau Kibe sekarang!” Eiri tergelak kecil. “Kecuali kau nak jadikan pencuci mulut?”

f6d65a8190ac.en: Harry’s voice sounded a bit mixed as embarrassment took over. “Eh—I guess true, sorry—” With a more resolute tone, courage finally came through to face Eiri’s snarkiness. “But I—” He took a deep breath. “I can’t shake off this feeling I’m getting! I don’t know what to do—it feels awful when I remember it.”
f6d65a8190ac.t: Suara Harry kedengaran sedikit bercampur ketika rasa malu mengambil alih. “Eh—rasanya betul juga, maaf—” Dengan nada yang lebih nekad, keberanian akhirnya datang untuk menghadapi sindiran Eiri. “Tapi saya—” Dia menarik nafas dalam. “Saya tak boleh buang perasaan yang saya rasa ni! Saya tak tahu apa nak buat—rasa teruk bila saya ingat.”

f6eacc113c55.en: Shit! I completely forgot about that. Harry was drying his face with a hand towel. “I need to go to Eiri right now!”
f6eacc113c55.t: Sial! Aku langsung lupa pasal tu. Harry sedang mengeringkan mukanya dengan tuala tangan. “Saya perlu pergi jumpa Eiri sekarang juga!”

f797ca1c17dc.en: “Just let it loose a bit—it will all work out!” Hiromi gently said, taking another gulp. His eyes glanced towards Kaiana’s breasts for a sec before looking back at his mug. “You two ready for food?”
f797ca1c17dc.t: “Lepaskan je sikit—semuanya akan beres!” Hiromi berkata dengan lembut, meneguk lagi. Matanya mengerling buah dada Kaiana sesaat sebelum kembali memandang kolenya. “Korang berdua dah sedia nak makan?”

f7bfd32646e3.en: “Really? Well, then this will be like a what-if story for ya.” Hiromi sat by Harry, wetting his lips with his coma-inducing jar of booze.
f7bfd32646e3.t: “Ye ke? Kalau macam tu, ni akan jadi macam cerita bagaimana-jika untuk kau.” Hiromi duduk di sebelah Harry, membasahkan bibirnya dengan balang araknya yang boleh menyebabkan koma.

f95e081a73c5.en: Sounding like a heavy smoker, Harry let out a cough filled with phlegm stuck deep in his lungs, almost choking himself in the process. “—where’s Eiri?” His voice sounded a bit croaky. “king-maid?—”
f95e081a73c5.t: Kedengaran seperti perokok tegar, Harry terbatuk dengan kahak yang tersekat jauh di dalam paru-parunya, hampir tercekik dalam proses itu. “—mana Eiri?” Suaranya kedengaran sedikit serak. “king-maid?—”

f96dfa8f225d.en: “I’m—” Harry’s smile began to wane, his blurry eyes noticing another familiar face in the room—Sora, the maid that made his heart flutter. Although it didn’t flutter this time, it pounded in his chest in fear. The tinnitus in his ear went off again, sounding as loud as a fire alarm. The awful energy inside him, which presumably was ejected from his mouth not long ago, resurfaced deep inside his bowels. With them, intrusive memories crept back into his mind. He placed his hand on his neck, feeling as if his breath was still being taken away.
f96dfa8f225d.t: “Saya—” Senyuman Harry mula pudar, matanya yang kabur perasan satu lagi wajah yang dikenali di dalam bilik—Sora, pembantu rumah yang membuat hatinya berdebar. Walaupun ia tidak berdebar kali ini, ia berdegup kencang di dadanya kerana takut. Tinnitus di telinganya berbunyi lagi, kedengaran sekuat penggera kebakaran. Tenaga buruk dalam dirinya, yang disangka sudah dikeluarkan dari mulutnya tidak lama tadi, muncul semula jauh di dalam ususnya. Bersamanya, ingatan-ingatan yang mengganggu merangkak kembali ke fikirannya. Dia meletakkan tangannya di lehernya, merasakan seolah-olah nafasnya masih dirampas.

f9847605ecea.en: Looking at the bag in Hiromi’s hand, Arukia’s eyes seemed thinkative for a second, but then she looked away. “I’m not touching that! Take that to Eiri yourself.” She sensually walked away, waving her hair around—perhaps trying to tease Harry and Hiromi with her swinging hips to gain upper hand in whatever game she was playing inside her head.
f9847605ecea.t: Memandang beg di tangan Hiromi, mata Arukia kelihatan berfikir seketika, tetapi kemudian dia mengalihkan pandangan. “Aku tak nak sentuh benda tu! Bawa sendiri kat Eiri.” Dia berjalan pergi dengan sensual, melambai-lambaikan rambutnya—mungkin cuba mengusik Harry dan Hiromi dengan pinggulnya yang berlenggang untuk mendapat kelebihan dalam apa sahaja permainan yang dimainkannya dalam kepalanya.

f994106dff7f.en: No response came back from Itanema.
f994106dff7f.t: Tiada jawapan yang kembali dari Itanema.

fa0f214723dc.en: Narrowing her face, Eiri nodded soon after. “I think I—yeah. Yeah. I remember it—hard stuff injected but no longer active! Yep! That was it—it was solid proof that your corpse came from the Sanbi slums in some shape or another. Sora wouldn’t lie about what she sensed.”
fa0f214723dc.t: Mengecilkan wajahnya, Eiri mengangguk tidak lama kemudian. “Rasanya aku—ha. Ha. Aku ingat—bahan berat disuntik tapi dah tak aktif! Ha’ah! Itulah dia—itu bukti kukuh yang mayat kau datang dari setinggan Sanbi dalam satu bentuk atau lain. Sora takkan tipu pasal apa yang dia rasa.”

fd2956e96eb0.en: Harry forcibly laughed as he felt the small leftovers of his once enormous love handles being squished. He tried to defend them against Eiri’s pinches, but her pinching abilities were far too masterful.
fd2956e96eb0.t: Harry ketawa dengan paksa ketika dia merasakan sisa kecil lemak tepi pinggangnya yang dahulu besar dicubit. Dia cuba mempertahankannya daripada cubitan Eiri, tetapi kebolehan mencubitnya terlalu mahir.

fe021ee8d753.en: “This girl injected something on me—on my neck. I remember it paralyzing me, making my mind murky. I can’t say for sure exactly when, but I think it happened on my first night here.” He closed his eyes, trying to relive it. Inside him, he could feel the anxiety rising. “The ceiling! The ceiling was the same ceiling as my bedroom, but it was nighttime. The—the girl suffocated me—”
fe021ee8d753.t: “Seorang gadis suntik sesuatu kat saya—kat leher saya. Saya ingat ia melumpuhkan saya, buat fikiran saya keruh. Saya tak boleh pastikan bila tepatnya, tapi saya rasa ia berlaku pada malam pertama saya kat sini.” Dia memejamkan matanya, cuba menghidupkannya semula. Di dalam dirinya, dia dapat merasakan keresahan meningkat. “Siling! Siling tu sama dengan siling bilik tidur saya, tapi waktu malam. Gadis—gadis tu lemaskan saya—”

fe35e5fbbce8.en: “HIROMI GANDEW TOUGH-HAMMER!” The voice reverberated through the parlor with such intensity that the window shook. “Now, say your name.”
fe35e5fbbce8.t: “HIROMI GANDEW TOUGH-HAMMER!” Suara itu bergema di ruang tamu dengan keamatan sehingga tingkap bergegar. “Sekarang, sebut nama kau.”

feb88db5bef3.en: Harry kept on standing there, with an estranged smile and wrinkled eyes forming as the thought of being turned down again was added to the pot of emotions. Lots of words flew through his mind, but he still just couldn’t develop a sentence.
feb88db5bef3.t: Harry terus berdiri di situ, dengan senyuman janggal dan mata berkedut terbentuk ketika fikiran ditolak lagi ditambah ke dalam periuk emosi itu. Banyak perkataan terbang di fikirannya, tetapi dia masih tidak dapat menyusun ayat.
